items.title_en: Benchmarking Protein Structure Tokenizers as Generation Targets for Language Models
items.title_zh: 将蛋白质结构分词器作为语言模型生成目标的基准评测
items.abstract_en: Discrete structure tokenizers are the standard way to give a language model access to protein three-dimensional structure, yet they are selected on how accurately they can be read, their reconstruction fidelity, while the property that governs generation is how well a model can write them. We measure this property, writability, directly: holding the base model, data, recipe and compute fixed, we swap only the tokenizer and train the same 9B model to emit structure tokens residue by residue, over eight tokenizers, four compute budgets and three evaluation sets (96 cells). At 2B tokens final writability runs from TM 0.662 down to 0.378 under identical conditions, with five of the eight arms clearing the TM 0.5 mark at which a fold is usually called correct and three falling short of it. Neither codebook size nor reconstruction ceiling explains where an arm lands; the best and worst both use 8192 codewords. What does explain the spread is local structure preservation of the code space. In DPLM-2 a one-bit codeword error costs 0.019 TM where a random codeword costs 0.347, and the trained model's own errors are correspondingly local, at 0.51 of the random Hamming expectation; FoldToken4 fails both tests at the same codebook size and is 0.13 TM less writable. Three controls discipline how such a benchmark may be read. A same-recipe rerun puts the noise floor at $σ=0.0067$ TM, which collapses an apparent six-way ranking into four tiers. A reference-free geometry panel turns out to be nearly orthogonal to TM (Pearson $-0.58$), with the worst arm by TM producing the most physically valid backbones. And two pre-registered interventions are null for a reason the mechanism measurements reveal: the quantity they target saturates at 1.5B tokens while TM is still rising. All 131 evaluation cells, including raw generated token streams, are released.
items.abstract_zh: 离散结构分词器是让语言模型获取蛋白质三维结构的标准方式，然而它们通常依据可被读取的准确程度（即重建保真度）来选择，而支配生成的属性是模型能够多好地写出它们。我们直接测量这一属性，即可写性：在固定基础模型、数据、训练配方和计算量的情况下，仅替换分词器，并在八个分词器、四种计算预算和三个评估集（96个单元）上训练同一个9B模型逐残基输出结构标记。在2B token时，相同条件下最终可写性从TM 0.662降至0.378，八个实验臂中有五个超过TM 0.5阈值（通常认为折叠正确），三个未达到。码本大小和重建上限都不能解释各实验臂所处的位置；最好和最差的都使用8192个码字。能够解释这种差异的是码空间的局部结构保持。在DPLM-2中，一位码字错误造成0.019 TM的损失，而随机码字造成0.347的损失，且训练模型自身的错误相应地具有局部性，为随机汉明期望的0.51；FoldToken4在相同码本大小下未通过这两项测试，可写性低0.13 TM。三项对照约束了此类基准的解读方式。同一配方重跑得到的噪声下限为σ=0.0067 TM，这将表面上六路排名压缩为四个层级。一个无参考几何评估面板结果与TM几乎正交（Pearson −0.58），TM最差的实验臂反而产生最物理有效的骨架。两项预注册干预无效，机制测量揭示了原因：它们针对的量在1.5B token时饱和，而TM仍在上升。全部131个评估单元，包括原始生成的token流，均已发布。

items.title_en: Native higher-order optimization with entropy quantum computing
items.title_zh: 使用熵量子计算的原生高阶优化
items.abstract_en: Higher-order interactions are common in applied optimization: parity checks, radar-code sidelobes, portfolio skewness and kurtosis, and marketing-channel synergies all yield cubic or quartic objectives. Quantum annealers and most Ising machines accept only quadratic objectives, and gate-based quantum processors build every higher-order term from two-qubit gates. Entropy quantum computing, realized in the hybrid photonic-electronic Dirac-3S system, accepts polynomials of degree up to five with all-to-all coupling over binary, integer or simplex-constrained continuous variables. No user-supplied quadratization or circuit compilation is needed. We formulate four industrial use cases as six cubic and quartic instances, run them on Dirac-3S with 30 samples each, and score every sample against a certified optimum or a classical best-known value. We also estimate their cost on quantum annealers, superconducting grids and trapped-ion registers under standard mappings. For the two densest instances, a portfolio with about 80,000 terms and a budget allocation with 360,000 terms, the quadratized problems need embeddings far beyond current annealers, over $10^5$ physical qubits for the portfolio alone, and one phase-separation layer costs over $10^6$ two-qubit gates before optimization. Dirac-3S ran all six natively and returned feasible, distinct solutions. All samples of the binary instances are single-flip local minima. The best portfolio sample lies within 0.32% of the best-known value and the best budget sample 15% above it, but no sample reached its reference. Classical solvers reach the references within minutes at these sizes, and random starts followed by a local polish reach comparable or better values, so the advantage established here is one of expressibility and mapping cost, not of solution quality. Whether it extends to time to solution at larger sizes remains open.
items.abstract_zh: 高阶交互在应用优化中很常见：奇偶校验、雷达码旁瓣、投资组合偏度和峰度以及营销渠道协同都会产生三次或四次目标函数。量子退火机和大多数Ising机仅接受二次目标，而基于门的量子处理器用双量子比特门构建每个高阶项。熵量子计算在混合光子-电子Dirac-3S系统中实现，接受最高五次的多项式，支持二元、整数或单纯形约束连续变量上的全连接耦合。无需用户提供二次化或电路编译。我们将四个工业用例构建为六个三次和四次实例，在Dirac-3S上各运行30个样本，并依据认证最优值或经典已知最佳值对每个样本评分。我们还估计了它们在标准映射下于量子退火机、超导网格和囚禁离子寄存器上的成本。对于两个最密集的实例——一个约80,000项的投资组合和一个360,000项的预算分配——二次化后的问题所需嵌入远超当前退火机，仅投资组合就需要超过10^5个物理量子比特，且优化前一个相位分离层就耗费超过10^6个双量子比特门。Dirac-3S原生运行了全部六个实例，并返回可行的不同解。二元实例的所有样本都是单翻转局部极小值。最佳投资组合样本与已知最佳值相差在0.32%以内，最佳预算样本高出15%，但没有样本达到其参考值。在这些规模下，经典求解器几分钟内即可达到参考值，随机起点后接局部精化可达到相当或更好的值，因此这里确立的优势在于可表达性和映射成本，而非解的质量。它是否能扩展到更大规模下的求解时间仍待研究。

items.title_en: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
items.title_zh: 图像生成能帮助视觉推理吗？一项实证研究
items.abstract_en: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型用词思考；那么多模态模型也许能用图像思考。我们测试生成的辅助图像是否能改善视觉问题的答案。模型描述其所需的辅助图像，然后结合原始图像和生成图像一起作答。在13个视觉-语言模型与生成器配对中，生成使平均准确率降低3.7个百分点，十个任务中有九个下降。两个统一模型BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B各自在八个任务上损失准确率。在VSTAR上，在相同规划提示中加入生成图像使准确率降低10.47个百分点。重复图像编辑在不同任务上产生不同结果。ChartQAPro和MathVista仍低于其无生成基线，而ERQA在十次编辑后提高三个百分点。

items.title_en: Too Smart for Its Own Good? Cognitive Fidelity and Competence Leakage in LLM Simulations of Young Learners
items.title_zh: 聪明反被聪明误？LLM模拟低龄学习者中的认知保真度与能力泄漏
items.abstract_en: LLM-based interactive learner simulators are increasingly used in educational applications, including teacher training and tutoring system development. A critical requirement for those simulations is cognitive fidelity: the simulated learner should maintain the assigned knowledge, misconceptions, and reasoning procedures throughout interaction. However, LLMs may express knowledge or problem-solving skills beyond the assigned learner's cognitive status, a phenomenon we refer to as competence leakage. In this exploratory study, we examine 3,339 simulated learner utterances from 130 teacher-learner simulator transcripts across three learning scenarios and identify over-competence as a prominent direction of cognitive-profile misalignment during interaction. We then investigate the recurrence of previously observed competence leakage cases under four matched-trigger evaluation protocols, ranging from isolated questioning to multi-turn interactions, across five model configurations. Overall, we observe higher violation recurrence under multi-turn protocols than under isolated question answering. More capable models generally show lower recurrence, whereas increased reasoning effort does not consistently improve cognitive fidelity and is even associated with slightly higher recurrence under multi-turn protocols in our matched-model comparison. These findings provide exploratory evidence of competence leakage phenomena in interactive learner simulation and suggest that single-turn question-answering type of evaluations alone may be insufficient, motivating the development of more systematic and reliable multi-turn protocols for evaluating cognitive fidelity in learner simulation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的交互式学习者模拟器正越来越多地用于教育应用，包括教师培训和辅导系统开发。这些模拟的一个关键要求是认知保真度：模拟学习者应在整个交互过程中保持所分配的知识、错误概念和推理过程。然而，LLM可能表现出超出所分配学习者认知状态的知识或问题解决技能，我们将这一现象称为能力泄漏。在这项探索性研究中，我们考察了来自三个学习场景的130份教师-学习者模拟器对话记录中的3,339条模拟学习者话语，并识别出过度胜任是交互过程中认知画像失配的一个突出方向。随后，我们在四种匹配触发评估协议下（从孤立提问到多轮交互），跨五种模型配置，研究先前观察到的能力泄漏案例的复现情况。总体而言，我们观察到多轮协议下的违规复现率高于孤立问答。能力更强的模型通常复现率更低，而增加推理努力并未持续改善认知保真度，在我们的匹配模型比较中，多轮协议下甚至与略高的复现率相关。这些发现为交互式学习者模拟中的能力泄漏现象提供了探索性证据，并表明仅靠单轮问答式评估可能不足，从而推动开发更系统和可靠的多轮协议来评估学习者模拟中的认知保真度。

items.title_en: Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 迈向智能体机器人：面向机器人使用智能体的Harness设计大规模研究
items.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以作为机器人使用智能体，理解多样场景并通过策略代码和工具控制机器人。然而，即使进行扩展推理，它们对3D夹爪位姿的预测仍然很差，难以完成精确操作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作（WAM）模型则相反：它们在训练任务上执行快速、平滑的控制，但在域偏移或任务需要长时程记忆和推理时失败。因此，智能体机器人通过策略harness将VLM推理和感知与精确的VLA/WAM控制结合起来。然而，harness设计涵盖数千种配置，在相同模型下成功率可相差数十个百分点。此外，即使测试一种设计也需要数千次rollout，API和GPU成本高昂，因此先前工作往往从少数备选中选定单一设计。为指导harness设计，我们在八个仿真基准、六个VLM和15个VLA/WAM检查点上评估了超过470,000次rollout。七项受控研究表明，有效的harness必须同时适应VLM和VLA/WAM的能力。我们的发现明确了VLM策略代码需要何种结构、VLA操作在何处需要工具和策略代码的帮助，以及何时在测试时引入VLM。参考配方X-Harness表明，这些发现无需权重更新即可组合，在记忆、推理和域偏移方面将基础策略提升最多+42.8个百分点。

items.title_en: One Patch, Many Policies: Object-Associated Physical Patch Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 一个补丁，多种策略：面向机器人操作的物体关联物理补丁攻击
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) are vulnerable to adversarial visual interference, motivating the study of universal and transferable physical patch attacks. We propose Object-Associated Patch Attack (OAPA), a universal and transferable physical patch framework that enables an attacker to select which task object's manipulation to disrupt through patch placement, without re-optimizing the patch. Our framework combines object-associated placement, differentiable physical compositing, and final action-expert representation divergence. Physical compositing accounts for perspective and occlusion across camera views, while representation divergence guides patch optimization using either relative RMS or cosine distance. Experimental results demonstrate strong attack transferability across task suites and policies, together with the ability to selectively disrupt manipulation of an attacker-chosen task object through patch placement.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界动作模型（WAMs）易受对抗性视觉干扰的影响，这促使人们研究通用且可迁移的物理补丁攻击。我们提出物体关联补丁攻击（Object-Associated Patch Attack, OAPA），这是一个通用且可迁移的物理补丁框架，使攻击者能够通过补丁的放置位置来选择干扰哪个任务物体的操作，而无需重新优化补丁。我们的框架结合了物体关联放置、可微物理合成以及最终动作专家表征发散。物理合成考虑了跨相机视角的透视与遮挡，而表征发散则使用相对 RMS 或余弦距离来引导补丁优化。实验结果表明，该攻击在不同任务套件与策略之间具有强迁移性，并且能够通过补丁放置选择性地干扰攻击者所选任务物体的操作。

items.title_en: A harmonized human glioblastoma single-cell chromatin accessibility atlas (snATAC-seq, 10 studies, 67 patients, 1.65M nuclei, 2.08M peaks)
items.title_zh: 一个统一的人类胶质母细胞瘤单细胞染色质可及性图谱（snATAC-seq，10 项研究，67 名患者，165 万个细胞核，208 万个峰）
items.abstract_en: As advancing molecular technologies begin to offer exquisite control over cellular processes, the bottleneck becomes our ability to deliver those tools into the specific cell types we want. The paradigm of identifying cell-type-specific enhancer sequences and testing their ability to drive cell-type-specific expression of transgenes has been tried with relatively impressive success in mouse models. It has not been tried to the same degree with enhancer data from humans, and certainly not in human neurological diseases that could benefit from cell-type-selective therapies. Because the first step of this process is compiling single-nucleus ATAC-sequencing data to identify cell-type-specific regions of open chromatin, we present a harmonized atlas of all publicly available IDH-WT glioblastoma snATAC-seq data at cell-type- and patient-level resolution (10 studies, 67 patients, 1,650,376 nuclei total). These are unified into a reference set containing 2,085,175 peaks. 75.7% of distal peaks are absent from the CATLAS reference adult human brain peak set, establishing the novel GBM-specific chromatin landscape across involved cell types. Peaks within recurrent CNV loci (chr7 EGFR, chr12 MDM2, chr8 MYC, chr9 CDKN2A) were flagged to distinguish copy-number inflation from genuine chromatin states. We generated per-cell-type candidate lists--malignant tumor cells, tumor-associated macrophages, resident microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, OPCs, excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons, endothelial cells, T cells, and an unassigned but likely-malignant cluster. We focus on peaks [≥] 2 kb from transcriptional start sites and detected in [≥]60% of evaluable patients (where a patient is evaluable for a given cell type if they contribute at least 50 quality cells of that type); a peak counts as detected in a patient if [≥]1% of that patients cells of the target type carry [≥]1 Tn5 fragment at the peak. Peaks are then scored per cell type by the mean of two percentile ranks: for strength, the patient-averaged, width-normalized Tn5 fragments per cell at the peak; and for specificity, the log2FC of (target-cell-type strength/next-highest-cell-type strength). Top hits recover expected lineage markers as top-ranked elements in their expected cell types--KDR at rank 1 of the endothelial list, CD3D at rank 4 of the T cell list, and MAG at rank 29 of the oligodendrocyte list--and nominate de novo distal enhancers for every lineage. This atlas is intended to facilitate cell-type-directed therapeutics but will be useful to the broader glioblastoma field. We have made openly available the full ranked lists for all cell types, an interactive and user-friendly HTML viewer, and the underlying pseudobulk matrix, along with per-cell AnnData h5ads for each cohort and an integrated h5ad file encompassing all included studies.
items.abstract_zh: 随着不断发展的分子技术开始提供对细胞过程的精细控制，瓶颈变成了我们将这些工具递送到所需特定细胞类型的能力。识别细胞类型特异性增强子序列并检验其驱动转基因细胞类型特异性表达的能力，这一范式已在小鼠模型中以相对令人瞩目的成功率得到尝试。该范式尚未在同等程度上利用来自人类的增强子数据进行尝试，更未在可能受益于细胞类型选择性疗法的人类神经系统疾病中进行尝试。由于该流程的第一步是汇总单核 ATAC 测序数据以识别细胞类型特异性的开放染色质区域，我们呈现了一个统一的图谱，涵盖所有公开可用的 IDH-WT 胶质母细胞瘤 snATAC-seq 数据，具备细胞类型与患者级别的分辨率（10 项研究，67 名患者，共 1,650,376 个细胞核）。这些数据被统一为一个包含 2,085,175 个峰的参考集。75.7% 的远端峰未出现在 CATLAS 参考成人脑峰集中，从而确立了所涉及各细胞类型中新颖的 GBM 特异性染色质景观。复发性 CNV 位点（chr7 EGFR、chr12 MDM2、chr8 MYC、chr9 CDKN2A）内的峰被标记出来，以区分拷贝数造成的信号膨胀与真实的染色质状态。我们生成了各细胞类型的候选列表——恶性肿瘤细胞、肿瘤相关巨噬细胞、驻留小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞、OPC、兴奋性神经元、抑制性神经元、内皮细胞、T 细胞以及一个未指派但可能为恶性的簇。我们关注距转录起始位点 ≥ 2 kb 且在 ≥60% 的可评估患者中被检出的峰（若某患者对某细胞类型贡献至少 50 个高质量该类型细胞，则该患者对该细胞类型可评估）；若某患者目标类型细胞中 ≥1% 的细胞在该峰上带有 ≥1 个 Tn5 片段，则该峰在该患者中被计为检出。随后，峰按细胞类型依据两个百分位排名的均值进行评分：强度为患者平均的、按宽度归一化的每细胞在该峰处的 Tn5 片段数；特异性为目标细胞类型强度与次高细胞类型强度之比的 log2FC。排名靠前的命中结果在其预期细胞类型中恢复了预期的谱系标记作为最高排名元件——KDR 在内皮细胞列表中排名第 1，CD3D 在 T 细胞列表中排名第 4，MAG 在少突胶质细胞列表中排名第 29——并为每个谱系提名了从头远端增强子。该图谱旨在促进细胞类型导向的治疗，但也将对更广泛的胶质母细胞瘤领域有用。我们已公开提供所有细胞类型的完整排名列表、一个交互式且用户友好的 HTML 查看器以及底层 pseudobulk 矩阵，此外还提供每个队列的单细胞 AnnData h5ad 文件和一个涵盖所有纳入研究的整合 h5ad 文件。

items.title_en: Cross-chip transfer in quantum photonic neural networks
items.title_zh: 量子光子神经网络中的跨芯片迁移
items.abstract_en: Fabrication variability makes it difficult to reuse one set of trained parameters across a batch of quantum photonic chips without additional chip-specific optimization. We examine how device-specific compensation and task tolerance shape cross-chip performance. For squared operator loss, local analysis predicts that reducing own-chip error through compensation incurs an increase in expected loss on independent chips. We use Monte Carlo ensemble training (MC-ENS), informed by an available statistical model of fabrication-induced parameter errors. It optimizes one shared parameter set for each task or target at a given fabrication scale by averaging losses over simulated chip realizations resampled from this model. Numerical simulations of a quantum photonic neural network compare MC-ENS with single-chip training, sharpness-aware training and a covariance-informed variant. For CNOT synthesis and Ising dynamics, MC-ENS reduces mean conditional process infidelity and increases mean postselection probability on unseen chips. In classification, high accuracy can persist despite substantial changes in the optical transformation. The decision-margin analysis shows when fabrication-induced score shifts are likely to change predicted labels. The trained shared parameters can be reused without device-specific retraining on unseen chips drawn from the same fabrication distribution.
items.abstract_zh: 制造变异性使得在不进行额外芯片特异性优化的情况下，难以将一组训练好的参数复用于一批量子光子芯片。我们考察了器件特异性补偿与任务容差如何塑造跨芯片性能。对于平方算子损失，局部分析预测：通过补偿降低本芯片误差会导致在独立芯片上的期望损失增加。我们采用蒙特卡洛集成训练（MC-ENS），其依据是可获得的制造诱导参数误差统计模型。该方法通过在从该模型重采样得到的模拟芯片实现上对损失取平均，针对给定制造尺度下的每个任务或目标优化一组共享参数。针对量子光子神经网络的数值仿真将 MC-ENS 与单芯片训练、锐度感知训练以及一种协方差知情变体进行比较。对于 CNOT 合成与 Ising 动力学，MC-ENS 降低了未见芯片上的平均条件过程不忠实度，并提高了平均后选择概率。在分类任务中，即使光学变换发生显著变化，高准确率仍可保持。决策裕度分析表明制造诱导的得分偏移何时可能改变预测标签。训练得到的共享参数可在来自同一制造分布的未见芯片上复用，而无需器件特异性再训练。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
items.title_zh: BRIAR：分岔引导推理树上的鞅信念平滑
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^π(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^π\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^π\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, BRIAR expands discourse-aligned reasoning trees along an upper-confidence outcome-bifurcation frontier, steering rollouts away from absorbed rumination and toward unresolved decision points. Second, it models latent node values with boundary-scaled heteroscedastic edge variances and computes exact global posteriors in linear $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ time via two-pass Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) tree belief smoothing, eliminating $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ matrix inversions while gating out spurious boundary noise. Third, BRIAR detects minimal absorbed frontier nodes and applies zero-sum log-length centered suffix advantages strictly post-absorption, leaving pre-absorption derivations provably invariant.
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已迅速推进长链推理，然而标准策略优化器会在一条轨迹上盲目地分配 rollout 计算与梯度信用。在难题上，早期的一步失误会使剩余轨迹脱轨；而在可解问题上，策略在答案早已确定之后仍不断生成冗余验证。我们将这两种病态追溯到同一个结构性事实：在 on-policy 验证器下，沿推理轨迹的真实前缀通过概率 $V^π(u)$ 构成一个 $[0,1]$ 有界的 Doob 鞅，其可学习的信用方差严格守恒，且上界为 $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$，在脱轨（$V^π\to 0$）与吸收（$V^π\to 1$）两个边界处均趋于零。我们提出 BRIAR（Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees），一个直接围绕该鞅几何构建的树结构 RLVR 框架。第一，BRIAR 沿置信上界结果分岔前沿扩展话语对齐的推理树，将 rollout 从已被吸收的反复咀嚼引向尚未解决的决策点。第二，它以边界缩放异方差边方差对潜在节点值建模，并通过两遍 Rauch--Tung--Striebel（RTS）树信念平滑在 $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ 线性时间内计算精确的全局后验，消除了 $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ 矩阵求逆，同时门控掉虚假的边界噪声。第三，BRIAR 检测最小吸收前沿节点，并严格在吸收之后施加零和的对数长度中心化后缀优势，使吸收之前的推导可证明地保持不变。

items.title_en: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
items.title_zh: NORMCRAFT：面向上下文感知语言模型对齐的文化规范生成
items.abstract_en: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.
items.abstract_zh: 文化对齐要求大语言模型（LLM）从情境及其文化语境中推断往往隐含的社会规范。现有方法通常对单个模型进行适配或提供外部文化知识，而独立于下游响应生成来学习规范推断仍鲜有探索。我们提出 NORMCRAFT，一个将规范推断与响应生成解耦的模块化框架。通过以规范为中心的多视图监督，我们将一个 LLM 训练为规范生成器，使其能够从预期、遵从与违反三类情境中恢复共享规范，而无需下游响应标签。生成的规范用于引导另一个独立的、冻结的 LLM（响应者）。以 Qwen3.5-4B 作为响应者，NORMCRAFT 在五项下游指标中的四项上优于提示与监督微调（SFT）基线。在 SafeWorld 上，其响应更频繁地（Coverage）且更精确地（Faithfulness）反映参考规范，分别超过响应者 SFT 18.0 与 14.1 个百分点。直接的规范评估也显示其规范质量高于基础生成器与少样本生成器。同一个训练好的生成器在 SafeWorld 上提升了十四个冻结 LLM 的文化对齐，这些模型跨越五个模型家族、参数量从 0.8B 到 27B，其中最小模型的增益最大。

items.title_en: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: RoboEvo$^2$：通过 Harness-策略协同演化的递归机器人自我改进
items.abstract_en: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人应当能够适应陌生环境并通过交互获得新技能，随后通过练习高效执行这些技能。视觉-语言-动作策略提供了高效控制，但通常需要额外的人类演示来处理陌生场景；推理智能体能够利用广泛的先验知识和机器人控制 API 发现解决方案，但反复的推理与修复代价高昂。受人类通过推理与实践进行学习的启发，我们提出 RoboEvo$^2$，一个用于递归式 harness-策略协同演化的框架。在策略到 Harness（P2H）演化中，策略的失败引导一个编码智能体搜索互补的 Code、Code+ICL 与 Code+Policy 路线，将验证过的解决方案整合为可复用技能、路由策略与经验记忆。在 Harness 到策略（H2P）演化中，已验证的轨迹提供监督训练，同时反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD）使策略学会偏好来自同一初始状态的成功修正而非失败。改进后的策略为后续搜索提供更强的运动技能，而其剩余失败则重新引导 harness 演化，从而闭合这一互惠回路。通过无需额外人类演示的递归协同演化，RoboEvo$^2$ 在 LIBERO-PRO 上将独立成功率从 11.0% 提升至 84.1%，将混合成功率从 30.4% 提升至 90.5%，并在 RoboTwin C2R 上取得类似增益并降低了智能体成本。进一步实验展示了自主任务获取、跨本体 harness 迁移，以及在 Unitree G1-D 上达到 95.0% 的混合成功率。我们的模型与代码将公开发布。

items.title_en: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
items.title_zh: Embodied-VGGT：为长序列重建保留可靠的局部几何
items.abstract_en: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.
items.abstract_zh: 长序列重建必须在纠正累积漂移的同时保留局部一致的几何。在机器人学和自动驾驶中，具身采集提供了重复出现的平台—环境几何结构，以及对场景结构和平台运动的重复观测。我们提出 Embodied-VGGT，利用这些线索建立可靠的局部关系，并在全局优化过程中有选择地保留这些关系。记忆增强接地块（Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks，MAGC）基于 Scal3R 的全局上下文记忆，使用由预测地面几何得到的相对尺度参考来正则化测试时记忆更新，在鼓励跨块一致性的同时限制对可靠局部几何的改动。超点对齐（Superpoint Alignment，SA）与跨环优化（Cross-Loop Optimization，CL）共同解决几何关系的稳健建立与保留问题。SA 在空间区域间平衡地面与非地面证据，以估计块间平移。CL 利用交错窗口间的几何与运动一致性选择一致的块组，每组在全局优化期间获得共享的 Sim(3) 校正，从而保留其内部相对变换。在五个公开驾驶基准上的实验表明，长序列重建获得一致且显著的提升。在 KITTI Odometry 上，Embodied-VGGT 达到 7.30 m 的平均绝对轨迹误差和 2.67 m 的 Chamfer 距离，在相同评估协议下相较最先进基线将这两项误差分别降低 46.8% 和 23.3%。为便于复现，我们发布了代码：https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Duodenal microbiota and associated environmental enteric dysfunction in undernourished Bangladeshi women and gnotobiotic mice
items.title_zh: 营养不良的孟加拉国女性与悉生小鼠中的十二指肠微生物群及相关环境性肠功能障碍
items.abstract_en: Undernutrition is an intergenerational global health challenge. Environmental enteric dysfunction (EED) is a small intestinal (SI) disorder characterized by villous atrophy, gut barrier dysfunction, malabsorption and systemic inflammation. To examine its pathogenesis and role in undernutrition, we performed esophagogastroduodenoscopy on undernourished Bangladeshi women with EED and their healthy counterparts. Histologic characterization of duodenal mucosal biopsies, aptamer-based proteomic analyses of their duodenal mucosa and plasma, plus metagenomic analyses of their duodenal and fecal microbiota, revealed associations between bacterial taxa and duodenal tissue and plasma proteomes indicative of EED. Colonization of germ-free female mice with consortia of duodenal bacteria from these women, followed by measurements of SI bacterial abundances, SI cellular patterns of gene expression (single nucleus RNA-seq), plus proteomic and flow cytometric analyses disclosed bacterial, epithelial, and immune features in dams and their offspring resembling those in the women. These findings have diagnostic and therapeutic implications.
items.abstract_zh: 营养不良是一项跨代全球健康挑战。环境性肠功能障碍（EED）是一种小肠（SI）疾病，特征为绒毛萎缩、肠道屏障功能障碍、吸收不良和全身性炎症。为探究其发病机制及在营养不良中的作用，我们对患有 EED 的营养不良孟加拉国女性及其健康对照进行了食管胃十二指肠镜检查。对十二指肠黏膜活检的组织学表征、对其十二指肠黏膜和血浆的基于适配体的蛋白质组学分析，以及对其十二指肠和粪便微生物群的宏基因组分析，揭示了细菌分类群与提示 EED 的十二指肠组织和血浆蛋白质组之间的关联。用这些女性的十二指肠细菌菌群定植无菌雌性小鼠，随后测量小肠细菌丰度、小肠细胞基因表达模式（单核 RNA 测序），并进行蛋白质组学和流式细胞术分析，揭示了母鼠及其子代中与这些女性相似的细菌、上皮和免疫特征。这些发现具有诊断和治疗意义。

items.title_en: PerovAgent: Autonomous Ligand Design for Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
items.title_zh: PerovAgent：卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶的自主配体设计
items.abstract_en: Designing surface-capping ligands for high-performance halide perovskite nanocrystals requires navigating a vast molecular space while discovering design rules that govern ligand-surface interactions. Here, we introduce PerovAgent, an autonomous multi-agent framework that combines large language model (LLM)-driven scientific reasoning with computational tools for atomistic model construction, machine-learned interatomic potential evaluation, and statistical validation. Across ten independent campaigns on CsPbBr3 surfaces, PerovAgent adaptively explored and refined diverse ligand chemistries while progressively improving the binding-energy objective. Beyond optimization, the framework converts recurring chemical observations into explicit design principles that can be statistically evaluated. Of 35 formulated principles, 19 were prospectively supported, of which seven also passed the confound audit, highlighting the need to systematically validate plausible LLM-generated hypotheses during autonomous discovery. A recurrent alkynyl-phosphonate principle was further examined using density functional theory, which reproduced the predicted energetic preference. These results demonstrate an autonomous discovery framework that not only searches molecular space and optimizes the scalar objective but also transforms its search trajectory into systematically testable design principles. The framework can also be extended to more complex ligands, including zwitterionic, multidentate, and polymerizable ligands, to explore a wider range of ligand-surface interactions and uncover new design principles for halide perovskite nanocrystals.
items.abstract_zh: 为高性能卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶设计表面封端配体，需要在广阔分子空间中导航，同时发现支配配体—表面相互作用的设计规则。在此，我们提出 PerovAgent，一个自主多智能体框架，将大语言模型（LLM）驱动的科学推理与用于原子模型构建、机器学习原子间势评估和统计验证的计算工具相结合。在 CsPbBr3 表面上的十次独立运行中，PerovAgent 自适应地探索并改进多样化的配体化学，同时逐步提升结合能目标。除优化之外，该框架还将反复出现的化学观察转化为可统计评估的明确设计原则。在 35 条提出的原则中，19 条得到前瞻性支持，其中 7 条还通过了混杂因素审查，凸显了在自主发现过程中系统验证 LLM 生成的可信假设的必要性。进一步使用密度泛函理论检验了一条反复出现的炔基膦酸酯原则，其重现了预测的能量偏好。这些结果表明，该自主发现框架不仅搜索分子空间并优化标量目标，还将其搜索轨迹转化为可系统检验的设计原则。该框架还可扩展到更复杂的配体，包括两性离子、多齿和可聚合配体，以探索更广泛的配体—表面相互作用，并揭示卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶的新设计原则。

items.title_en: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
items.title_zh: 通过变分双模拟实现干扰物鲁棒的强化学习
items.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）有望带来数据效率和泛化能力，但典型的基于重建的目标鼓励模型将表征能力浪费在与任务无关的干扰物上。我们提出 VIBES（Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States，基于双模拟编码状态的变分推断），一种用对抗项替代像素重建的新目标，强制潜在状态足以预测奖励和下一潜在状态。我们表明，该目标衡量编码器距离奖励充分性和动力学充分性有多远，并且只要精确充分性可达到，其全局最优解就会在历史上诱导双模拟关系。结合固定容量的潜在瓶颈，这鼓励潜在状态保留任务相关信息，同时丢弃无关变化。我们的方法可作为 Dreamer 模型学习组件的即插即用替代，在 Distracting Control Suite 上达到最先进性能，并扩展到 Realistic ManiSkill 中视觉复杂的操作任务。与先前方法不同，它不依赖图像特定的增强，并且同样适用于高维向量状态任务，并在 100 连杆游泳机器人上得到演示。最后，潜在空间分析（UMAP 嵌入和最近邻探测）证实，学习到的表征对任务相关结构敏感，而对干扰物不变。

items.title_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
items.title_zh: 雅可比空间中的柏拉图表征假设：语言模型与视觉模型近似一致至一个旋转
items.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.
items.abstract_zh: 柏拉图表征假设（PRH）认为，即使在不同数据模态上训练，AI 模型也会收敛到对世界的共享表征。先前工作已在视觉和语言模型的激活中发现支持 PRH 的证据。在本工作中，我们追问视觉和语言模型是否也在其作用于这些表征的方式上收敛：确切地说，在这些内部表征如何影响模型输出方面。在 transformer 的选定层，雅可比透镜为词汇表中的每个词（或图像分类器中的每个类别）给出隐藏状态中的一个向量：该向量最能增加模型在该位置或之后生成该词的倾向，或预测该类别的倾向。这些向量共同构成所谓的模型 J 空间。我们在跨视觉和语言模型的 J 空间中发现 PRH 的证据，并且进一步发现 J 空间大多在旋转意义下收敛。也就是说，在词子集上拟合的单个旋转可近似地将一个模型的 J 空间映射到另一个模型的 J 空间，因而也适用于其未拟合的词和类别。将一个词的向量从纯文本语言模型的 J 空间旋转到视觉语言模型的视觉图块 token 中，会改变视觉语言模型所说的图像中的物体（且仅在添加它的图像区域中）。旋转到图像生成器的文本条件中，一个词的向量会改变生成图像中的物体。旋转到 ImageNet 分类器（无文本训练）中，它会将该物体的类别分数提高到几乎高于所有其他类别，反之亦然。这表明模型不仅在表征世界的方式上收敛，也在作用于世界的方式上收敛。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation
items.title_zh: 通过循环状态蒸馏实现敏捷四旋翼的端到端图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航要求机器人在没有地图或目标位姿的情况下到达目标照片的视点。在三维环境中，这不仅需要识别目标，还需要估计三维位移并生成连续控制动作，以接近并稳定在目标视图。这很困难，因为当前图像与目标图像之间相同的视觉差异可能因机器人速度不同而需要非常不同的动作，而仅凭单目图像既无法揭示度量尺度，也无法揭示机体运动。因此，现有图像目标策略局限于平面动作空间，并依赖状态估计器进行飞行控制。直接从图像映射到低级控制指令的策略已在敏捷飞行中得到演示，但尚未在未见环境中面向目标图像得到演示。我们提出首个图像目标导航策略，可直接输出推力和角速率指令，用于在未见三维环境中进行敏捷四旋翼飞行，且不依赖状态估计（例如 SLAM、VO 或 SfM）或单独的速度控制器。我们通过四阶段流程训练基于循环视觉的策略，该流程将几何与运动监督与特权教师蒸馏以及端到端强化学习微调相结合。在未见环境中的 1000 次留出飞行中，该策略在成功飞行中达到 82.3% 的成功率，平均终端位置误差为 0.10 m。在真实四旋翼上零样本部署时，该策略在未见室内环境中的 25 次试验中达到 84% 的成功率。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting
items.title_zh: DriftWAM：通过动作感知视频漂移实现更快的世界-动作模型
items.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAM）将未来视频预测与动作生成统一起来用于机器人控制，但其对迭代去噪的依赖带来可观的推理开销。将此类模型蒸馏为少步生成器是高效部署的一条有前景的途径，但在激进的步数缩减下保持任务性能仍具挑战。现有方法依赖逐点轨迹一致性蒸馏，其在优化视频生成时追求高视觉保真度，却未利用下游动作信息，且缺乏显式的分布级对齐。为此，我们提出 DriftWAM，一种少步 WAM 蒸馏框架，将预测视频所诱导的动作纳入视频学习。具体而言，DriftWAM 集成了动作感知视频漂移，通过联合视觉-动作相似度核执行视频分布匹配，以在这些诱导动作的引导下驱动样本演化；以及动作引导视频正则化，利用联合核识别出的兼容教师-学生匹配，将动作级梯度直接反传至视频生成器。在 RoboTwin 2.0 与 LIBERO 基准以及真实机器人操作任务上的评估表明，在相同推理速度下，DriftWAM 在各类少步设置中持续优于先前的一致性蒸馏方法。

items.title_en: Automating postmarketing pharmacovigilance with large language model agents
items.title_zh: 用大语言模型智能体实现上市后药物警戒的自动化
items.abstract_en: Postmarketing pharmacovigilance relies on spontaneous adverse event reporting and labor-intensive observational studies, which suffer from underreporting and delayed risk detection. Large language model (LLM) agents could automate real-world evidence generation, but generalist agents make ad hoc analytical decisions that compromise epidemiological validity and reproducibility. Here we present MedCheckpoint, a multi-agent LLM system for automated postmarketing pharmacovigilance. MedCheckpoint grounds each analytical stage in a curated, source-traceable medical knowledge base, locks core study-design parameters before execution, performs patient-level analyses with human-written deterministic statistical tools, and enforces checkpoint rules that abort infeasible analyses, with optional human-in-the-loop review. We evaluated MedCheckpoint using a 54-question benchmark on a dual-purpose simulated electronic health record (EHR) testbed of 2.7 million individuals, designed with reliable clinical signals to evaluate routine analytical accuracy alongside spurious signals to stress-test system rigor. Across the benchmark, MedCheckpoint outperformed two coding-agent baselines in report quality across five dimensions rated by three independent LLM judges (overall means 4.81-4.88 versus 4.25-4.55 and 4.02-4.29) and yielded higher run-to-run consistency (mean within-question standard deviation 0.116-0.186 versus up to 0.440). Crucially, while baselines failed on up to 2 of 21 runs when handling infeasible comparisons or unmeasurable outcomes, MedCheckpoint produced no misleading failures across all seven stress-test trap questions with known data limitations. MedCheckpoint enables reliable, auditable, and scalable pharmacovigilance analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 上市后药物警戒依赖自发不良事件报告与劳动密集的观察性研究，存在报告不足与风险检测延迟的问题。大语言模型（LLM）智能体有望实现真实世界证据生成的自动化，但通用型智能体做出临时性的分析决策，会损害流行病学有效性与可复现性。在此我们提出 MedCheckpoint，一个用于自动化上市后药物警戒的多智能体 LLM 系统。MedCheckpoint 将每个分析阶段建立在经策展、来源可追溯的医学知识库之上，在执行前锁定核心研究设计参数，使用人工编写的确定性统计工具进行患者级分析，并执行检查点规则以中止不可行的分析，同时可选人在环审核。我们使用一个含 54 个问题的基准，在包含 270 万人的双用途模拟电子健康记录（EHR）测试平台上评估 MedCheckpoint；该平台设计有可靠的临床信号以评估常规分析准确性，并含有虚假信号以对系统严谨性进行压力测试。在该基准上，MedCheckpoint 在由三名独立 LLM 评审按五个维度评定的报告质量上优于两个编码智能体基线（总体均值 4.81–4.88 对 4.25–4.55 与 4.02–4.29），并具有更高的运行间一致性（问题内标准差均值 0.116–0.186 对最高 0.440）。关键在于，基线在处理不可行比较或不可测量结局时在至多 21 次运行中有 2 次失败，而 MedCheckpoint 在所有七个已知数据局限性的压力测试陷阱问题上均未产生误导性失败。MedCheckpoint 使药物警戒分析可靠、可审计且可扩展。

items.title_en: Transport Layer-Driven Optimization of Color and Efficiency in TADF OLEDs for Large-Area Applications
items.title_zh: 面向大面积应用的 TADF OLED 中颜色与效率的传输层驱动优化
items.abstract_en: Balancing structural simplicity with high efficiency is crucial for practical applications of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), especially in large-area lighting devices. Optimizing the charge-transport layers in multilayer OLEDs controls the recombination zone within the emissive layer, thereby enhancing the device's performance. Herein, we experimentally and computationally investigate how the thicknesses of the electron and hole transport layers affect the performance of orange-red thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) OLEDs. Using a TADF emitter, 2-[4-(diphenylamino)phenyl]-10,10-dioxide-9H-thioxanthen-9-one (TXO-TPA), at 10 wt\% concentration in 4,4-Bis(N-carbazolyl)-1,1-biphenyl (CBP) host, we achieve a maximum external quantum efficiency ($η_{EQE}$) of 20.86\% and a peak luminance of 32,800 cd m$^{-2}$. Using a combination of drift-diffusion and optical simulations, we reveal how variations in hole- and electron-transport-layer thicknesses modulate the charge-carrier balance and shift the recombination zone within the emissive layer. This tuning not only optimizes exciton formation but also enables color tuning from green to red without altering the emissive material. Our findings highlight the critical role of transport layer engineering in achieving efficient, color-controlled OLEDs with simplified architectures. Furthermore, we successfully demonstrate a large-area OLED device (~20 cm$^{2}$), achieving an impressive $η_{EQE}$ of 17\%, underscoring the scalability and practicality of our approach for general lighting applications.
items.abstract_zh: 在结构简洁性与高效率之间取得平衡对于有机发光二极管（OLED）的实际应用至关重要，尤其是在大面积照明器件中。优化多层 OLED 中的电荷传输层可控制发光层内的复合区，从而提升器件性能。本文通过实验与计算研究电子传输层和空穴传输层的厚度如何影响橙红色热活化延迟荧光（TADF）OLED 的性能。使用 TADF 发光体 2-[4-(二苯氨基)苯基]-10,10-二氧化-9H-噻吨-9-酮（TXO-TPA），以 10 wt% 浓度掺入 4,4-双(N-咔唑基)-1,1-联苯（CBP）主体中，我们实现了 20.86% 的最大外量子效率（$η_{EQE}$）与 32,800 cd m$^{-2}$ 的峰值亮度。结合漂移-扩散与光学模拟，我们揭示了空穴传输层与电子传输层厚度的变化如何调制电荷载流子平衡并移动发光层内的复合区。该调控不仅优化了激子形成，还能在不改变发光材料的情况下实现从绿光到红光的颜色调谐。我们的发现凸显了传输层工程在实现结构简化、高效且颜色可控的 OLED 中的关键作用。此外，我们成功演示了约 20 cm$^{2}$ 的大面积 OLED 器件，实现了 17% 的 $η_{EQE}$，凸显了我们的方法在通用照明应用中的可扩展性与实用性。

items.title_en: Spec2Weights: Certifying Networks that a Language Model Writes from a Specification
items.title_zh: Spec2Weights：为语言模型依据规范写出的网络提供认证
items.abstract_en: A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a plain-language specification, with no data and no gradient step. We ask when such a network can be proved exact in the float32 arithmetic it actually runs in. A float-safety lemma makes exhaustive float32 enumeration a proof for any summation order, and a layered error bound covers networks whose weights are not short binary fractions. With dynamic programming, template checks, an SMT proof, breadth-first search and induction for weight-tied recurrences, this certifies 12 of 15 written networks (one after a single constant fix) on every input of a stated domain (up to $10^{16}$ inputs, or every graph or grid up to a size bound), in a minute of CPU or less each. The certificates also say where a network stops being exact: the shortest-path network is exact iff the distance is at most 4,096 and fails at the predicted hops. Thirty new specifications were each written by a fresh session of one model family (Claude Opus 5.5). Twenty-five first submissions are certified exact for any summation order; the five tax schedules stay within \$0.11 of the true tax at every whole dollar in one fixed float32 run. An open 27B model passes 23 of the 30, and 25 with more thinking and code execution, so the method transfers in part. We also prove two limits of learning from examples: input coordinates never active in training cannot be learned from more in-range data, and Luhn-type checksums have exponentially small target-dependent gradient variance across their family. Tuned gradient descent on the same architectures agrees with both, which cover two of our five failure classes.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型可以依据自然语言规范写出小型 MLP、CNN、RNN 或 GNN 的权重，无需数据也无需梯度步骤。我们追问：何时能够证明这样的网络在其实际运行的 float32 算术下是精确的。一个浮点安全性引理使穷举 float32 枚举成为对任意求和顺序的证明，而分层误差界覆盖权重不是短二进制小数的网络。借助动态规划、模板检查、SMT 证明、广度优先搜索以及对权重绑定递归的归纳，该方法在给定定义域的所有输入（最多 $10^{16}$ 个输入，或规模上界内的每个图或网格）上认证了 15 个写出的网络中的 12 个（其中一个在单次常数修正后），每个耗时一分钟 CPU 或更少。证书还指明了网络在何处不再精确：最短路径网络当且仅当距离至多 4,096 时精确，并在预测的跳数处失败。三十个新规范各由一个模型家族（Claude Opus 5.5）的一个全新会话写出。二十五个首次提交被认证为对任意求和顺序精确；五个税率表在一次固定的 float32 运行中在每个整数美元处与真实税额的偏差保持在 $0.11 以内。一个开放的 27B 模型通过 30 个中的 23 个，在更多思考与代码执行下通过 25 个，因此该方法可部分迁移。我们还证明了从样例中学习的两个局限：训练中从未激活的输入坐标无法从更多范围内数据中学到；Luhn 型校验和在其家族上的目标相关梯度方差呈指数级小。在相同架构上调优的梯度下降与这两点一致，它们涵盖了我们五个失败类别中的两个。

items.title_en: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
items.title_zh: 当墨迹遇见像素：面向经人工修正的财务文档的 VLM 意图感知 OCR
items.abstract_en: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.
items.abstract_zh: 文档上的人工标注（如箭头、插入符号、删除线和插入内容）表达了修正意图，然而现有 OCR 与文档理解系统将这些标记视为视觉噪声，而非语义编辑操作。我们提出意图感知 OCR，即通过联合推理原始文档内容与传达编辑意图的视觉意图线索（手写或数字）来生成修正后转写的任务。为支持这一设定，我们提出 DocIntent，一个包含 1,600 份财务文档、逾 5,700 个已标注视觉意图线索的多模态数据集，每个线索均配有布局感知、意图已解析的 OCR 目标。我们进一步提出 IntentBench，一个含 216 份文档的基准，用于评估模型在多样真实标注条件下的稳健性。利用 DocIntent，我们在修正转写上的直接意图监督下微调 DocIntentOCR，一套 3B 与 7B 参数的视觉-语言模型。在 IntentBench 上，微调后的 3B 与 7B 模型分别取得 0.81 与 0.83 的 F1 分数，显著优于商业闭源模型（如 GPT-4.1（0.626））与开源模型（如 LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）），表明意图感知监督使紧凑的领域专用模型在该任务上优于规模大得多的通用系统。本工作将意图感知 OCR 确立为一种新的人在环文档理解任务，并提供基础资源（数据集、基准、模型）以推进交互式文档处理研究。

items.title_en: FOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian Splats for Gaussian Robots
items.title_zh: FOCI：在高斯泼溅上为高斯机器人进行轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently gained popularity as a faster alternative to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in 3D reconstruction and view synthesis methods. Leveraging the spatial information encoded in 3DGS, this work proposes FOCI (Field Overlap Collision Integral), an algorithm that is able to optimize trajectories directly on the Gaussians themselves. FOCI leverages a novel and interpretable collision formulation for 3DGS using the notion of the overlap integral between Gaussians. The formulation presented applies to different robot morphologies (e.g., fixed and mobile base manipulators, legged robots, UAVs) and handles both static and dynamic Gaussian-Splat environments. Contrary to other approaches, which represent the robot with conservative bounding boxes that underestimate the traversability of the environment, we propose to represent the environment and the robot as Gaussian Splats. This not only has desirable computational properties, but also allows for orientation-aware planning, allowing the robot to pass through very tight and narrow spaces. We extensively test our algorithm in both synthetic and real Gaussian Splats, showcasing that collision-free trajectories for legged, aerial and manipulator robots can be computed in seconds, even with hundreds of thousands of Gaussians making up the environment. The code is available at https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci
items.abstract_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）近来作为 NeRF 的更快替代方案，在三维重建与视图合成方法中受到欢迎。利用 3DGS 中编码的空间信息，本工作提出 FOCI（Field Overlap Collision Integral，场重叠碰撞积分），一种能够直接在高斯本身上优化轨迹的算法。FOCI 利用高斯间重叠积分的概念，为 3DGS 提出了一种新颖且可解释的碰撞表述。所提出的表述适用于不同的机器人形态（如固定基座与移动基座机械臂、腿足机器人、无人机），并处理静态与动态高斯泼溅环境。与其他用保守包围盒表示机器人、从而低估环境可通行性的方法相反，我们提出将环境与机器人均表示为高斯泼溅。这不仅具有理想的计算性质，还允许朝向感知的规划，使机器人能够穿过非常狭窄逼仄的空间。我们在合成与真实高斯泼溅中广泛测试了该算法，展示了即使环境中包含数十万个高斯，也能在数秒内计算出腿足、空中与机械臂机器人的无碰撞轨迹。代码见 https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏输入视图优化底层的连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视角方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置$(x,y,z)$和观察方向$(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视角，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Age-Dependent Association of Tumor Mutational Burden With Overall Survival in Patients With Melanoma
items.title_zh: 黑色素瘤患者中肿瘤突变负荷与总生存期关联的年龄依赖性
items.abstract_en: Importance: Estimates of the association of tumor mutational burden (TMB) with overall survival in melanoma come largely from pan-cancer subgroups or immunotherapy-restricted cohorts, and whether host factors modify TMB's prognostic value is unclear. Objective: To determine whether TMB is independently associated with overall survival in a clinically sequenced melanoma cohort, and whether patient age modifies that association. Design, Setting, and Participants: This retrospective cohort study at a US academic health system included patients with registry-confirmed melanoma whose tumor tissue, collected from January 2012 to May 2024, was sequenced on a clinically implemented targeted next-generation sequencing panel (OncoPanel). Vital status was ascertained through the National Death Index, Massachusetts death records, and electronic health records, with follow-up through September 7, 2025. Data were analyzed from April to November 2026. Exposures: TMB, analyzed continuously (per doubling) and dichotomized at the 10 mutations/megabase threshold ("TMB-high"). Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcome was overall survival from the date of genomic specimen collection (sequencing). Secondary outcomes were overall survival from diagnosis and melanoma-specific survival. Results: A total of 1063 patients (635 [59.7%] male; 1027 [96.6%] White; median age at sequencing, 65.6 years [IQR, 56.1-74.0]) were included, and 445 (41.9%) died. TMB-high status was associated with better overall survival after adjustment for age, sex, and noncutaneous subtype (hazard ratio [HR], 0.63; 95% CI, 0.51-0.79). Median overall survival was 10.2 vs 4.8 years for TMB-high vs TMB-low patients (log-rank P < .001). Each doubling of TMB was associated with an adjusted HR of 0.80 (95% CI, 0.73-0.87), with no evidence of nonlinearity (P 3 = .31). The association weakened with increasing age (interaction HR per decade, 1.29; 95% CI, 1.11-1.50; P < .001). The adjusted TMB-high HR was 0.41 (95% CI, 0.29-0.58) at age 50 years and 0.88 (95% CI, 0.66-1.19) at 80 years. Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) were received by 823 (77.4%) patients. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cohort study, TMB from clinically implemented, targeted next-generation sequencing panels was associated with overall survival as a continuous gradient, and the association weakened with increasing age. Because most patients received ICIs, prognostic and predictive contributions could not be separated.
items.abstract_zh: 重要性：关于黑色素瘤中肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）与总生存期关联的估计主要来自泛癌亚组或限于免疫治疗的队列，且宿主因素是否修饰TMB的预后价值尚不清楚。目的：确定在一个临床测序的黑色素瘤队列中，TMB是否与总生存期独立相关，以及患者年龄是否修饰该关联。设计、设置和参与者：这项在美国一个学术健康系统开展的回顾性队列研究纳入登记确认的黑色素瘤患者，其2012年1月至2024年5月收集的肿瘤组织在临床实施的靶向下一代测序panel（OncoPanel）上测序。生命状态通过国家死亡指数、马萨诸塞州死亡记录和电子健康记录确定，随访至2025年9月7日。数据分析时间为2026年4月至11月。暴露：TMB，按连续变量（每倍增）分析，并以10个突变/兆碱基阈值为二分变量（“TMB高”）。主要结局和指标：主要结局为从基因组标本采集（测序）日期起的总生存期。次要结局为从诊断起的总生存期和黑色素瘤特异性生存期。结果：共纳入1063例患者（635例[59.7%]男性；1027例[96.6%]白人；测序时中位年龄65.6岁[IQR，56.1-74.0]），445例（41.9%）死亡。调整年龄、性别和非皮肤亚型后，TMB高状态与更好的总生存期相关（风险比[HR]，0.63；95% CI，0.51-0.79）。TMB高与TMB低患者的中位总生存期分别为10.2年与4.8年（log-rank P < .001）。TMB每倍增与调整后HR 0.80相关（95% CI，0.73-0.87），无非线性证据（P 3 = .31）。该关联随年龄增加而减弱（每十年交互HR，1.29；95% CI，1.11-1.50；P < .001）。在50岁时，调整后TMB高HR为0.41（95% CI，0.29-0.58），在80岁时为0.88（95% CI，0.66-1.19）。823例（77.4%）患者接受了免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）。结论和意义：在这项队列研究中，来自临床实施的靶向下一代测序panel的TMB以连续梯度方式与总生存期相关，且该关联随年龄增加而减弱。由于大多数患者接受了ICI，预后和预测贡献无法分开。

items.title_en: Deep-learning-enabled rapid spatially multiplexed wavefront sensing with a thin diffuser
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的薄漫射器快速空间复用波前传感
items.abstract_en: Conventional wavefront sensing typically measures aberrations along a single guide-star direction, limiting the correction of field-dependent aberrations over a wide field of view. Spatial multiplexing with a thin diffuser enables simultaneous measurements across multiple isoplanatic patches, but the computational cost of reconstruction makes it difficult to track changing aberrations. We propose a deep-learning approach that combines recurrent all-pairs field transforms for displacement estimation with Zernike coefficient regression. Experimental results show that the method accurately reconstructs multiple wavefronts from a single speckle pattern and reduces three-channel reconstruction time from 2801.6 ms with conventional digital image correlation (DIC) to 23.1 ms. The reconstructed wavefronts agreed more closely with sequential single-channel references than those obtained by multiplexed DIC, and simulations showed that Zernike regression was more robust to noise than direct gradient integration. These results suggest a path toward dynamic wide-field aberration sensing and high-speed adaptive optics.
items.abstract_zh: 传统波前传感通常沿单一导星方向测量像差，限制了在宽视场内对场依赖像差的校正。使用薄漫射器的空间复用能够在多个等晕区同时测量，但重建的计算成本使得难以跟踪变化的像差。我们提出一种深度学习方法，将用于位移估计的循环全对场变换与Zernike系数回归相结合。实验结果表明，该方法能够从单个散斑图案中准确重建多个波前，并将三通道重建时间从传统数字图像相关（DIC）的2801.6 ms降低到23.1 ms。重建波前与顺序单通道参考的吻合程度高于复用DIC获得的结果，仿真表明Zernike回归比直接梯度积分对噪声更稳健。这些结果表明了一条通向动态宽场像差传感和高速自适应光学的路径。

items.title_en: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
items.title_zh: 当我们可以读取世界模型时，还需要强化学习吗？
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. Further analyses reveal interpretable decision rules and how they evolve through feedback-driven refinement. Comparisons with policies generated without source code access and experiments under challenging conditions further demonstrate the benefits of readable world models. These findings suggest that direct policy synthesis can reduce reliance on trial and error, challenging the necessity of task-specific RL training.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习在序贯决策中取得了显著成功，但学习有效策略通常需要大量交互经验。基于模型的强化学习通过利用世界模型来缓解这种依赖，世界模型通常用于支持规划或策略优化。在本文中，我们研究一种替代范式，其中自主的基于LLM的编码智能体通过对可读世界模型进行推理来直接合成控制策略。通过检查环境源代码，这些智能体将环境知识转化为可执行的决策规则，并使用在线反馈或离线数据迭代改进其策略，而无需任务特定的RL训练。在不同决策基准上的实验表明，合成的策略匹配或优于传统RL方法，同时所需经验显著更少。进一步分析揭示了可解释的决策规则以及它们如何通过反馈驱动的改进而演化。与未访问源代码生成的策略的比较以及在挑战性条件下的实验进一步证明了可读世界模型的好处。这些发现表明，直接策略合成可以减少对试错的依赖，挑战了任务特定RL训练的必要性。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: DRBench Pro：面向专业深度研究智能体的以知识为中心的基准
items.abstract_en: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 深度研究智能体从多个来源收集信息，并将其综合为针对复杂、开放式问题的报告。现有基准从多个维度评估报告质量，但缺乏专门的以知识为中心的评估，用以衡量报告覆盖哪些研究方向以及对这些方向探索的深度。我们提出DRBench Pro，一个将结构化知识覆盖作为主要评估目标的基准。我们的自动化流水线从Wikipedia构建本地知识树，并使用采样子图生成研究查询和以证据为依据的评分细则。每条评分细则对应知识树中的一个关系，从而保留被评估知识的结构。智能体仅接收研究查询。这种结构使我们能够衡量跨主要研究方向的广度以及沿相关知识链的深度，并以二者的几何平均值给出总体覆盖度。该基准包括跨24个领域的144个案例和44,102条评分细则。对16个深度研究智能体的评估揭示了在广度和深度上的不同优势，表现最好的智能体达到57.04%的总体覆盖度。评分细则判断与人工标注高度一致，且智能体排名在测试的指标配置下保持稳定。

items.title_en: AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System
items.title_zh: AirLeg：一个鲁棒且准确的自监督视觉-惯性-腿部SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-惯性-腿部（VIL）状态估计为腿式机器人提供了具有成本效益的定位，只需在机载IMU和关节编码器之外增加一个相机。然而，基于学习的腿部里程计受其监督的限制：在仿真中训练的网络存在仿真到现实的差距，而真实世界标签需要昂贵的传感器或继承视觉估计的误差。为解决这个问题，我们提出AirLeg，一个自监督VIL SLAM系统，其中视觉和腿部本体感受从训练到部署相互改进。我们在仿真中预训练腿部里程计网络，并通过命令式学习在没有真值的情况下使其适应机器人；其中多传感器捆绑调整使用腿部里程计来细化视觉地图，而视觉地图反过来监督网络。在部署期间，融合估计在线适应网络。为改进定位和这种监督，双窗口估计器融合视觉、IMU和腿部里程计，通过变形感知约束将受载足与视觉重建地形相关联，并通过方差分量估计对约束加权。AirLeg完成了全部17个GrandTour序列，在19种方法中平均误差最低（0.19 m）。在低成本四足机器人上，它仅用0.5小时未标注数据就实现了最低漂移（0.6%），并在嵌入式计算机上实时运行。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
items.title_zh: WorldBridge：桥接零散视图以实现连贯的3D世界生成
items.abstract_en: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time optimization. We also introduce the WorldBridge benchmark suite to evaluate 3D world generation from scattered, low-overlap references, which is rarely explored by current benchmarks. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method enables controllable and coherent 3D world generation, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art solutions. Our project page is available at https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/.
items.abstract_zh: 从视觉重叠很少或没有视觉重叠的零散图像生成连贯且可探索的3D世界，是计算机视觉中一项基础且长期存在的挑战，现有几何感知方法未能解决该问题。同时，现有基于图像和视频的方法可能生成未见区域，但在不同视图之间产生不一致的几何。为弥合这一差距，我们提出WorldBridge，一个用于在视觉重叠很少或没有视觉重叠的零散图像下生成连贯且可控3D世界的框架。WorldBridge将零散参考编码为全局场景上下文，以指导跨视图的几何与外观生成。我们的时间与空间参考注意力机制进一步增强沿目标轨迹的时间参考保真度，并支持其外部的灵活空间参考。一种即插即用的潜在参考一致性策略通过重投影引导的测试时优化提高参考保真度。我们还引入WorldBridge基准套件，用于评估从零散、低重叠参考生成3D世界，这一问题当前基准很少探索。定性和定量结果均表明，我们的方法能够实现可控且连贯的3D世界生成，超越现有最先进解决方案。项目页面见https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Exercise misinformation in fitness content targeted at women on Instagram and TikTok: a cross-sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts
items.title_zh: Instagram和TikTok上针对女性的健身内容中的运动错误信息：对6,982条帖子的横断面内容分析
items.abstract_en: ObjectivesTo quantify exercise misinformation in female-targeted exercise content on Instagram and TikTok, determine whether content textually targeted at women carries higher rates of misinformation, and compare content from creators self-identifying as ethnic minority with other content. MethodsCross-sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts collected March to June 2026 by manual browsing, which captured on-screen and caption text, and automated collection, which captured captions only. Text was coded for claim accuracy, textual female targeting and creator characteristics, with large language model-assisted coding verified against an independent human coder. Effects were estimated by logistic regression using adjustment sets from a pre-specified causal diagram, with creator-clustered standard errors. ResultsOf 6,524 posts, 2,447 made an assessable exercise claim, of which 600 (24.5%, 95% CI 22.8 to 26.2) contained misinformation. Textually female-targeted content carried more than twice the odds of misinformation compared with untargeted content (OR 2.06, 95% CI 1.58 to 2.70), particularly wholly inaccurate content. The effect was OR 4.00 (2.41 to 6.66) where on-screen text was captured and 1.04 (0.73 to 1.49) where only captions were (interaction p < 0.001). Content from creators self-identifying as ethnic minority carried less misinformation (OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.92). Conclusion24.5% of fitness posts making a verifiable claim contained misinformation, and content directed at women had higher rates where the full written text could be read. Posts naming a body part were most likely to be inaccurate, giving clinicians and public health communicators a teachable marker of misinformation. Key messages What is already known on this topicO_LIHealth misinformation is common on social media, and fitness content aimed at women has been linked to harmful impacts on mood, body image and exercise behaviour. C_LIO_LIExisting research concentrates on YouTube or small samples, is rarely gender-specific, and contains no ethnic minority sub-analyses. C_LI What this study addsO_LIOne in four posts making a verifiable exercise claim contained misinformation, and textually female-targeted content carried more than twice the odds of untargeted content -- four times the odds where on-screen text (in addition to caption text) could be read. C_LIO_LIContent directed at women implicitly, by naming a body part, carried higher odds of misinformation than content explicitly addressing a female audience, and was more likely to be wholly inaccurate. C_LIO_LIContent from creators self-identifying as ethnic minority carried less misinformation, not more. C_LI How this study might affect research, practice or policyO_LIWomen navigate a measurably worse exercise information environment on social media, and the misinformation directed at them is disproportionately about altering body shape rather than enhancing their capability; this framing is already linked to negative biopsychosocial effects on women. C_LIO_LIGiven the content with the highest odds of being wholly inaccurate never addresses women directly, advice and policy aimed at explicitly gendered marketing will miss most of it; appraisal must be based on what a post claims, not on whom it addresses. C_LIO_LIClinicians have a usable rule: content naming a body part and promising a shape warrants scepticism; content describing a practice and a capability warrants less. The element most likely to be false is the promised outcome, not the exercise. C_LIO_LICommercial intent and self-described "coach" status are weak discriminators of misinformation and should not be regarded? as warning signs. C_LI
items.abstract_zh: 目的：量化Instagram和TikTok上针对女性的健身内容中的运动错误信息，确定文本上针对女性的内容是否具有更高的错误信息率，并比较自我认同为少数族裔的创作者内容与其他内容。方法：对2026年3月至6月收集的6,982条帖子进行横断面内容分析；人工浏览采集屏幕文字和配文文本，自动收集仅采集配文。文本按主张准确性、文本女性针对性和创作者特征进行编码，大语言模型辅助编码由独立人工编码者验证。效应通过逻辑回归估计，使用预先指定因果图中的调整集，并采用创作者聚类标准误。结果：在6,524条帖子中，2,447条提出了可评估的运动主张，其中600条（24.5%，95% CI 22.8至26.2）包含错误信息。文本上针对女性的内容相比未针对性内容，包含错误信息的比值比高出一倍以上（OR 2.06，95% CI 1.58至2.70），尤其是完全不准的内容。在采集到屏幕文字的情况下，效应为OR 4.00（2.41至6.66）；在仅采集配文的情况下为1.04（0.73至1.49）（交互作用p < 0.001）。自我认同为少数族裔的创作者内容包含的错误信息较少（OR 0.69，95% CI 0.51至0.92）。结论：24.5%提出可验证主张的健身帖子包含错误信息，而在可读取完整书面文本时，面向女性的内容错误信息率更高。点名身体部位的帖子最可能不准确，为临床医生和公共卫生传播者提供了一个可教学的错误信息标志。关键信息 本主题已知内容：健康错误信息在社交媒体上很常见，针对女性的健身内容与对情绪、身体意象和运动行为的有害影响有关。现有研究集中于YouTube或小样本，很少具有性别特异性，且没有少数族裔亚组分析。本研究新增内容：四分之一提出可验证运动主张的帖子包含错误信息，文本上针对女性的内容相比未针对性内容的错误信息比值比高一倍以上——在可读取屏幕文字（除配文文本外）的情况下，比值比高四倍。通过点名身体部位来隐式针对女性的内容，相比明确面向女性受众的内容，具有更高的错误信息比值比，且更可能完全不准。自我认同为少数族裔的创作者内容包含的错误信息较少，而非更多。本研究可能如何影响研究、实践或政策：女性在社交媒体上面对的运动信息环境在可测量意义上更差，针对她们的错误信息不成比例地涉及改变体型而非增强其能力；这种框架已与对女性的负面生物心理社会影响相关联。鉴于完全不准比值比最高的内容从不直接针对女性，针对明确性别化营销的建议和政策将错过其中大部分；评估必须基于帖子声称什么，而不是针对谁。临床医生有一个可用的规则：点名身体部位并承诺体型的内容值得怀疑；描述一种实践和一种能力的内容则较少需要怀疑。最可能为假的要素是承诺的结果，而非运动本身。商业意图和自述“教练”身份是错误信息的弱区分因素，不应被视为警告信号。

items.title_en: High-Dimensional Single-Photon Frequency Conversion for Orbital Angular Momentum Comb State
items.title_zh: 轨道角动量梳态的高维单光子频率转换
items.abstract_en: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) degree of freedom provides an important resource for constructing high-dimensional optical quantum information systems. However, the generation of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state and its high-fidelity frequency conversion remain challenging due to limited spatial modulation resolution, imperfect mode matching, and finite nonlinear conversion efficiency. Here, we proposed and experimentally demonstrated a scalable scheme for the generation and frequency conversion of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state. We prepared a single-photon OAM comb state with a dimension of up to 128, achieving a fidelity of 0.787 between the reconstructed and target states and an effective dimension of 100. Furthermore, using the sum-frequency generation, we demonstrated the frequency upconversion of single-photon high-dimensional OAM comb state from the communication band to a visible wavelength of 520 nm, while verifying the preservation of both the OAM mode distribution and phase information through density matrix reconstruction. Our work established a versatile platform for the generation, manipulation, and characterization of high-dimensional OAM comb states, with potential applications in cross-band quantum information transfer, high-capacity quantum communication, and high-dimensional quantum networks.
items.abstract_zh: 轨道角动量（OAM）自由度是构建高维光学量子信息系统的重要资源。然而，由于有限的空间调制分辨率、不完美的模式匹配以及有限的非线性转换效率，高维单光子OAM梳态的生成及其高保真频率转换仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出并实验演示了一种可扩展方案，用于高维单光子OAM梳态的生成和频率转换。我们制备了维度高达128的单光子OAM梳态，重建态与目标态之间的保真度为0.787，有效维度为100。此外，利用和频产生，我们演示了单光子高维OAM梳态从通信波段到520 nm可见波长的频率上转换，同时通过密度矩阵重建验证了OAM模式分布和相位信息均得以保留。我们的工作为高维OAM梳态的生成、操纵和表征建立了一个通用平台，在跨波段量子信息传输、大容量量子通信和高维量子网络中具有潜在应用。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Decision-Aligned Value Learning for Selective Adoption of EEG Fusion in Human-Robot Collaboration
items.title_zh: 决策对齐的价值学习用于人机协作中选择性采用脑电融合
items.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) captures neural activity associated with human perception and decision-making. It provides human-robot collaboration (HRC) systems with measurable evidence for event recognition, situation assessment, and action preparation. External sensing cannot easily provide such evidence. However, the quality and complementarity of this evidence vary across samples, and existing EEG fusion methods do not explicitly determine when EEG improves a prediction. We therefore framed selective EEG use as a sample-wise incremental-value estimation problem and proposed Value Estimation and Constraint-Aware Triage for Adoption (VECTA). VECTA separates the generation of an EEG-informed Fusion prediction from the decision about whether it should replace the existing Base prediction. The framework uses system gain to quantify the loss reduction from Base to Fusion and matching gain to assess whether benefits arise from sample-matched EEG. A signed-value learner estimates system gain from decision-time evidence and prioritizes high-value Fusion outputs under budget constraints. Cross-subject evaluations on three HRC datasets showed that matched Fusion outperformed shuffled controls. Estimated gains tracked realized gains, with Spearman correlations of 0.347-0.612 and positive-gain areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) of 0.708-0.842. Under budget constraints, VECTA reduced Brier loss and harmful Fusion adoption and achieved the highest mean normalized AUBC across three datasets among the selective-decision methods evaluated. Validation on three external multi-modal datasets showed that VECTA could be applied directly as a post-hoc decision layer to task-specific predictors without retraining. These results show that selective Fusion adoption can translate the uneven utility of EEG into system-level gains.
items.abstract_zh: 脑电图（EEG）捕获与人类感知和决策相关的神经活动。它为人机协作（HRC）系统提供用于事件识别、态势评估和动作准备的可测量证据。外部传感不易提供此类证据。然而，这种证据的质量和互补性因样本而异，现有EEG融合方法并未明确判定EEG何时能改善预测。因此，我们将选择性使用EEG框定为逐样本增量价值估计问题，并提出用于采用的价值估计与约束感知分诊（VECTA）。VECTA将生成由EEG信息支持的Fusion预测与是否应取代现有Base预测的决策分离。该框架使用系统增益量化从Base到Fusion的损失降低，并使用匹配增益评估收益是否来自样本匹配的EEG。一个带符号价值学习器从决策时证据估计系统增益，并在预算约束下优先输出高价值Fusion。在三个HRC数据集上的跨被试评估表明，匹配的Fusion优于打乱对照。估计增益与实现增益一致，Spearman相关系数为0.347-0.612，正增益的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.708-0.842。在预算约束下，VECTA降低了Brier损失和有害的Fusion采用，并在所评估的选择性决策方法中，于三个数据集上取得最高的平均归一化AUBC。在三个外部多模态数据集上的验证表明，VECTA可直接作为事后决策层应用于任务特定预测器，而无需重新训练。这些结果表明，选择性采用Fusion可将EEG的不均匀效用转化为系统级增益。

items.title_en: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
items.title_zh: 稳定的Gated DeltaNet-2：理解并缓解循环状态不稳定性
items.abstract_en: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training. We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes. To resolve this, we propose \model{}, employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility. Theoretically, we establish an $O(\sqrt{T})$ upper bound on recurrent state growth while retaining chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on ~1.6B parameter models show that \model{} achieves stable training alongside improved long-context retrieval. Compared to GDN-2, it boosts the 128K average RULER score by 6.80 points in the recurrent setting and average accuracy across nine downstream tasks by 0.62 points in the hybrid setting.
items.abstract_zh: 线性注意力通过线性复杂度和固定大小循环状态，为长序列建模提供高效解决方案。Gated DeltaNet-2（GDN-2）在擦除和写入方面引入独立的逐通道控制，增强了状态更新表达能力和上下文内检索，但它在长上下文训练期间会出现训练失败。我们将这些失败追溯到擦除期间读取方向与修改方向之间的不对称性，这种不对称产生非正规擦除算子，其方向增益会跨token累积，即使没有新的写入也会触发状态指数增长。为解决此问题，我们提出 \model{}，采用对称擦除以确保非扩张状态传播，并采用衰减调节的残差写入以保持写入灵活性。理论上，我们在保留分块并行计算的同时，建立了循环状态增长的O(√T)上界。在约1.6B参数模型上的实验表明，\model{}在实现稳定训练的同时改善了长上下文检索。与GDN-2相比，它在循环设置中将128K平均RULER分数提高6.80分，在混合设置中将九个下游任务的平均准确率提高0.62分。
