items.title_en: Did the Model Forecast It, or Already Know It? Evaluating Large Language Models for Novel Drug-Target Prioritisation with a Temporal Knowledge-Graph Oracle
items.title_zh: 模型是预测了它，还是早已知道它？利用时间知识图谱预言器评估大语言模型对新药靶点优先级排序的能力
items.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly help decide which drug targets enter costly clinical trials. We recast each target-disease hypothesis as a dated event, the pair's first clinical trial. This lets us test whether a language model can forecast such events after its training cutoff, rather than recall events before it. We rebuild a dated biomedical knowledge graph as it stood at the end of each year from 2020 up to its newest version. We then ask six open language models, with and without this graph, which targets will enter a first trial for a disease the next year. Without retrieval, the models rank about as well as trial history, a count of each target's past trials in the same therapeutic area, also after their training cutoffs. Evidence dated before the decision adds at most a small gain, before or after the models' training cutoffs. The newest graph raises five of six models clearly above that baseline, but its paths usually include the answer: the pair's own trial, dated after the decision. Evaluations of target prioritisation should date both features and labels, with evidence from before the decision and outcomes after it.
items.abstract_zh: AI 系统越来越多地帮助决定哪些药物靶点进入昂贵的临床试验。我们将每个靶点-疾病假设重新表述为一个带日期的事件，即该配对的首个临床试验。这使我们能够检验语言模型是否能在其训练截止时间之后预测此类事件，而不是回忆截止时间之前的事件。我们重建了一个带日期的生物医学知识图谱，使其处于从 2020 年起每年年末直至其最新版本的状态。然后，我们询问六个开放语言模型，在有和没有该图谱的情况下，哪些靶点将在下一年进入针对某种疾病的首个试验。在没有检索的情况下，这些模型的排序表现大约与试验历史相当；试验历史是对每个靶点在同一治疗领域中过去试验的计数，且同样在其训练截止时间之后。无论模型训练截止时间之前还是之后，日期早于决策的证据最多只带来小幅增益。最新图谱使六个模型中的五个明显高于该基线，但其路径通常包含答案：该配对自身的试验，其日期晚于决策。靶点优先级排序的评估应当同时标注特征和标签的日期，特征使用决策之前的证据，结果使用决策之后的结果。

items.title_en: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
items.title_zh: 多模高斯节点中 steering 与远程 Wigner 负性的精确单配性
items.abstract_en: Optical quantum networks route correlations through nodes that hold several modes and are linked to many neighbors. Steering is the correlation behind one-sided device-independent tasks and behind the remote preparation of non-Gaussian states. It is monogamous for a single mode, which can be steered by only one party, but how many neighbors can steer a node with $k$ modes was not known. We show that for Gaussian states the answer is exactly $2k-1$ when the neighbors use Gaussian measurements, with any number of measurement settings. The limit follows from a simple bound. To every neighbor we assign a share, computed from the covariance matrix, and we prove that the shares of all neighbors add up to at most $k$, irrespective of the amount of squeezing, amplification or noise the network contains. A neighbor steers the node by Gaussian measurements exactly when its share exceeds one half, and a network built from a harmonic tight frame reaches the limit. The same number governs remote Wigner negativity. A heralded non-Gaussian operation at the node can make at most $2k-1$ neighbors Wigner negative, and in our network a single heralded projection makes all of them negative in the same run. With $n$ settings of arbitrary measurements, at most $nk-1$ neighbors can steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it. More than $2k-1$ neighbors can therefore steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it only if they use non-Gaussian measurements with at least three settings, whereas entanglement can reach any number of neighbors. These results determine exactly how many neighbors one multimode node can serve with steering and with remote Wigner negativity.
items.abstract_zh: 光学量子网络通过节点路由相关性，这些节点持有多个模式并连接到许多邻居。Steering 是单边设备无关任务以及非高斯态远程制备背后的相关性。对于单个模式，它是单配的，即只能被一方 steering；但一个具有 k 个模式的节点能被多少个邻居 steering 此前并不清楚。我们证明，对于高斯态，当邻居使用高斯测量且测量设置数量任意时，答案恰好是 2k−1。该限制来自一个简单界。我们为每个邻居分配一个份额，该份额由协方差矩阵计算得到，并证明不论网络包含多少压缩、放大或噪声，所有邻居的份额之和至多为 k。一个邻居通过高斯测量 steering 该节点，当且仅当其份额超过二分之一；由调和紧框架构建的网络可达到该极限。同一个数目也支配远程 Wigner 负性。节点处的预报型非高斯操作最多可使 2k−1 个邻居具有 Wigner 负性，而在我们的网络中，单次预报型投影可在同一次运行中使所有这些邻居均为负。当使用 n 个任意测量的设置时，至多有 nk−1 个邻居能够 steering 该节点或与其违反 Bell 不等式。因此，超过 2k−1 个邻居要 steering 该节点或与其违反 Bell 不等式，只有当它们使用至少三种设置的非高斯测量时才可能；而纠缠可以到达任意数量的邻居。这些结果精确确定了一个多模节点能够以 steering 和远程 Wigner 负性服务多少个邻居。

items.title_en: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
items.title_zh: 细胞类型特异性表达难以从 bulk 预测，但仍然有用
items.abstract_en: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.
items.abstract_zh: 基于单细胞信息的去卷积为临床 bulk RNA 队列提供细胞类型分辨的特征。大多数现有方法预测 K 个组成细胞类型（CT）的比例 π_k。较少方法预测基因 g 在 CT k 中的细胞类型特异性表达（CTSE）μ_kg，这可以捕捉比例所遗漏的细胞状态，但近期基准发现其预测难度大得多。我们用闭式准确率界解释这一差距。对于 CTSE，我们推导了逐基因线性估计器的 R^2 上限。对于比例，最佳线性估计器汇集跨基因的证据，具有闭式 R^2，并且其一个可计算下界可预测哪些 CT 可学习。我们研究了 106 个经生物学整理的（CT，基因）对的靶向去卷积，这些对在事后被发现具有更高的可学习性分数。在非小细胞肺癌的总生存期上，估计难度并不能预测这些靶点的预后价值。然而，一个基于去卷积特征（主要是 CTSE）的稀疏生存模型，其预测生存的效果与基于 bulk 基因本身的稀疏模型一样好，同时将其信号归因于特定细胞类型。一些去卷积 CTSE 特征揭示了相应 bulk 基因中未见到的预后信号。

items.title_en: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
items.title_zh: PINN-Slicer：利用旋转对称性求解黑洞周围的光子轨道方程
items.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below $10^{-3}$ in $u = r_s/r$ (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.
items.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）通常难以处理长跨度定义域，往往需要随着定义域增长而重新训练网络。我们提出 PINN-Slicer，一种用于二阶自治常微分方程 \ddot{u}=G(u,\dot{u}) 的方法，它利用该类方程在自变量平移下的不变性。一个单独的 PINN 被嵌入到一个显式施加初始条件的解拟设中，并使用 Sobol 采样的初始条件在自变量的薄切片上训练。随后，该 PINN 在整个定义域上逐片递归部署。我们在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上演示 PINN-Slicer，相对于有限差分参考解，在 u = r_s/r（以 Schwarzschild 半径为单位的逆径向坐标）中达到逐点均方根误差（RMSE）低于 10^{-3}。PINN-Slicer 的一个关键优势是，单个已训练网络无需重新训练即可泛化到训练范围内的任意轨道初始条件。此外，PINN-Slicer 能够处理可能并非先验已知的解定义域。

items.title_en: How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering?
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言场景图作为具身问答记忆的效果如何？
items.abstract_en: Embodied QA needs memory, but answer accuracy mixes retained evidence, reading errors and question priors. For a simulated multi-room scene-graph pipeline we define answerability: the fraction of questions a fixed rule-based reader answers correctly from the graph alone. The baseline recovers 24.1% of visible object types and its room labels flicker. Four targeted repairs double recall, raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4%, and improve retrained QA from 71.4% to 75.9%, yet better object F1 can lower answerability. A question-type prior beats this reader on every predicted graph. In one real-video test, graph memory lowers accuracy. These exploratory findings favour scoring retained evidence alongside accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 具身问答需要记忆，但答案准确率混合了被保留的证据、读取错误和问题先验。对于一个模拟的多房间场景图流程，我们定义可回答性：固定的基于规则的读取器仅凭该图正确回答的问题比例。基线恢复了 24.1% 的可见物体类型，且其房间标签会闪烁。四项针对性修复使召回率翻倍，将可回答性从 27.2% 提高到 37.4%，并将重新训练的问答从 71.4% 提高到 75.9%，然而更好的物体 F1 可能降低可回答性。问题类型先验在每个预测图上都优于该读取器。在一项真实视频测试中，图记忆降低了准确率。这些探索性发现支持在准确率之外对被保留证据进行评分。

items.title_en: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
items.title_zh: ShowNow：面向响应式世界模型的细粒度推测流式
items.abstract_en: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式世界模型必须持续生成视频，同时及时响应用户动作。仅靠实时吞吐量仍无法解决输入延迟：粗粒度生成块会延迟动作更新，而输入后生成又会在响应路径上增加工作。我们提出 ShowNow，一个细粒度推测流式框架，它利用播放期间可用的计算，在输入到达之前准备以动作为条件的未来。单潜在提交使频繁决策成为可能，而可配置的准备覆盖 1 至 8 个动作。我们构建了一个匹配的多未来数据集，用于训练从共同状态出发的备选延续；共享历史树执行与融合提交使这些准备高效。在单块 H100 上，我们的 5B 模型在准备八个未来时以 16 fps 维持 480p 生成。在 ViZDoom 中，相对于原生块 SolarWM-FT 部署，完整的 ShowNow 部署将输入到显示的中位延迟从 620 ms 降至 208 ms。匹配策略实验将重启空 ticks 从 1.56% 降至 0.09%（94%），并改善对动作变化的按时响应。这些结果确立了细粒度提交与提前准备的互补作用，同时测量了视觉保真度和长时程一致性方面的权衡。ShowNow 将播放时计算转化为响应式视觉交互。项目：https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow。

items.title_en: Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao Reconstruction of Discrete space Population Dynamics
items.title_zh: 离散空间种群动力学的 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao 重建
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing the continuous time dynamics of cell state evolution from sparse snapshot observations can be formulated as an unbalanced optimal transport problem. To study such dynamics at a coarse grained cell type level, unbalanced optimal transport must be extended to discrete state spaces. Inspired by discrete flow matching, we extended the dynamic Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) problem to discrete spaces, and derived a closed form for its solution. For particularly large state spaces or more general models, we proposed an unbalanced discrete flow matching as a numerical approximation method, which provides a Markovian reconstruction of the optimal WFR flow. Our discrete WFR framework also stays stable across different coarse grain resolution. Finally, numerical experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed approach, and applications to real biological data supported the plausibility of the reconstructed dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 从稀疏快照观测重建细胞状态演化的连续时间动力学，可被表述为一个非平衡最优传输问题。为了在粗粒度细胞类型层面研究此类动力学，必须将非平衡最优传输扩展到离散状态空间。受离散流匹配启发，我们将动态 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）问题扩展到离散空间，并推导出其解的闭式形式。对于特别大的状态空间或更一般的模型，我们提出非平衡离散流匹配作为一种数值近似方法，它为最优 WFR 流提供马尔可夫重建。我们的离散 WFR 框架在不同粗粒化分辨率下也保持稳定。最后，数值实验证明了所提方法的有效性，对真实生物数据的应用支持了重建动力学的合理性。

items.title_en: A Reconfigurable Four-State Sensor Based on Orthogonal Thermal and Chemical Stimuli
items.title_zh: 基于正交热与化学刺激的可重构四态传感器
items.abstract_en: This article presents a novel four-state refractive index (RI) sensor based on distinct phases of palladium (Pd) and vanadium dioxide (VO$_2$), controlled by orthogonal thermal and chemical stimuli. This is a numerical, simulation-only study: all results are obtained from two-dimensional finite-element method (FEM) simulations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported multi-state reconfigurable RI sensor tuned by external control. VO$_2$ serves as a phase change material (PCM) offering two thermally switchable phases with highly contrasting optical properties, while the hydrogen absorption property of Pd provides two additional phases. Combining these, four operational states are realized: (i) $α$-Pd/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (ii) $β$-PdH$_x$/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (iii) $α$-Pd/high-$T$ VO$_2$; and (iv) $β$-PdH$_x$/high-$T$ VO$_2$. Thermal crosstalk between Pd and VO$_2$ is mitigated through tungsten (W) doping of VO$_2$. This work further introduces conditional state sensitivity (CSS), a novel figure of merit quantifying the optical contrast between each state transition. The proposed sensor achieves a peak sensitivity of 2871 nm/RIU for the undoped reference configuration and 2798 nm/RIU for the practical W-doped device, together with a peak CSS of 16,872 nm/RIU, establishing it as a multi-state reconfigurable platform with reduced thermal crosstalk and potential applications in industrial safety monitoring and optical logic gates.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于钯（Pd）和二氧化钒（VO$_2$）不同相的新型四态折射率（RI）传感器，由正交的热刺激和化学刺激控制。这是一项仅数值仿真的研究：所有结果均来自二维有限元法（FEM）仿真。据我们所知，这是首个报道的通过外部控制调谐的多态可重构 RI 传感器。VO$_2$ 作为相变材料（PCM），提供两种具有高度对比光学性质的热切换相，而 Pd 的氢吸收特性提供另外两个相。结合这些相，实现四个工作状态：(i) $α$-Pd/低温 VO$_2$；(ii) $β$-PdH$_x$/低温 VO$_2$；(iii) $α$-Pd/高温 VO$_2$；(iv) $β$-PdH$_x$/高温 VO$_2$。Pd 与 VO$_2$ 之间的热串扰通过 VO$_2$ 的钨（W）掺杂得到缓解。本工作进一步引入条件状态灵敏度（CSS），一种量化每次状态转换之间光学对比度的新品质因数。所提出传感器在未掺杂参考配置中达到 2871 nm/RIU 的峰值灵敏度，在实际 W 掺杂器件中达到 2798 nm/RIU，同时峰值 CSS 为 16,872 nm/RIU，使其成为一个具有降低热串扰的多态可重构平台，并有望应用于工业安全监测和光学逻辑门。

items.title_en: SysBio-SR: Benchmarking Symbolic Regression for Trajectory Fidelity and Mechanism Recovery in Systems Biology
items.title_zh: SysBio-SR：系统生物学中轨迹保真度与机制恢复的符号回归基准测试
items.abstract_en: Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dynamical systems from data. In systems biology, however, accurately reproducing system trajectories does not necessarily imply recovery of the underlying reaction mechanisms. Existing benchmarks evaluate numerical accuracy, expression complexity, or equation-level similarity, but not agreement between recovered reactions and reference mechanisms in biological systems. We introduce SysBio-SR, a benchmark of 198 literature-based biological ODE systems with reaction annotations spanning mass action, Michaelis--Menten, Hill, and complex kinetics. Trajectory fidelity is evaluated across all systems under in-distribution reconstruction and out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation, while mechanism recovery is assessed on the subset of 161 systems. We evaluate trajectory fidelity across 11 symbolic-discovery methods and assess mechanism recovery for three reaction-based methods. Joint analysis across systems highlights how severely trajectory-based evaluation overestimates true mechanism recovery. Motivated by these findings, we develop KineSelect, a framework that searches candidate reaction topologies under biologically grounded kinetic laws to select optimal mechanisms that balance trajectory fidelity with structural parsimony. Compared with the strongest baseline, KineSelect improves aggregate OOD extrapolation \(R^2\) by 19.2\% and overall reaction F1 score by 14.3\%.
items.abstract_zh: 符号回归旨在从数据中发现动力系统的可解释控制方程。然而在系统生物学中，准确复现系统轨迹并不必然意味着恢复潜在反应机制。现有基准评估数值精度、表达式复杂度或方程级相似度，但不评估所恢复反应与生物系统中参考机制之间的一致性。我们提出 SysBio-SR，一个包含 198 个基于文献的生物 ODE 系统的基准，带有反应注释，涵盖质量作用、Michaelis-Menten、Hill 和复杂动力学。轨迹保真度在所有系统上于分布内重建和分布外（OOD）外推下评估，而机制恢复在 161 个系统的子集上评估。我们评估 11 种符号发现方法的轨迹保真度，并评估三种基于反应的方法的机制恢复。跨系统的联合分析突显了基于轨迹的评估在多大程度上严重高估真实机制恢复。受这些发现启发，我们开发 KineSelect，一个在具有生物学依据的动力学定律下搜索候选反应拓扑的框架，以选择在轨迹保真度与结构简约性之间取得平衡的最优机制。与最强基线相比，KineSelect 将总体 OOD 外推 R² 提高 19.2%，总体反应 F1 分数提高 14.3%。

items.title_en: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
items.title_zh: Skill Lift 实际测量的是什么？对 SkillsBench 的源代码级审计与噪声感知再分析
items.abstract_en: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.
items.abstract_zh: Agent 技能是由编码智能体按需加载的指令、参考材料和脚本目录。根据 SkillsBench，尽管人工整理的技能平均可将通过率提高约 16.6 个百分点（pp），但实际上它们降低了一些任务的结果。后续研究已开始根据上述逐任务增益来门控或消除技能。我们在源代码层面对上述基准进行了审计，并分析了 7,554 次公开试验，形成 1,421 个配对的“（配置，任务）单元”。源代码审计识别出两个经控制验证的评分器依赖案例和一个操作定义缺口；这三个任务上的平均提升为 74.6 pp，全集总体平均提升为 18.7 pp。审计还发现四个任务包含占位技能目录，且某一执行框架在大多数运行中额外添加了 48 个内置技能。在采用多重检验校正的合并再分析中，没有任何任务级降低达到统计显著性。由于每个单元每种条件最多只有三次运行，观测到的负差异非常容易受到运行采样噪声影响；从算术上看，58% 的单元本不可能显示下降。因此，负向单元的原始数量不能表明技能会造成损害。基于无技能分数的门控策略在日志中似乎提高了 2-3 pp；然而，即使在打乱条件标签以消除任何技能效应后，它仍实现了 4-7 pp 的提高。在未用于拟合和决策的留出运行上，没有统计学显著改善。审计台账和分析脚本已由我们发布。

items.title_en: $μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
items.title_zh: μMPC：通过 Koopman 线性化预编译实现从边缘到 GPU 的微秒级非线性与世界模型控制
items.abstract_en: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 μMPC，一个快速模型预测控制（MPC）框架，利用学习到的 Koopman 线性化动力学减少在线计算。通过预计算有限时域的控制到输出映射，μMPC 消除了提升状态轨迹，得到仅含动作的 Koopman 编译 QP（KC-QP），其决策变量为 H n_u，且与提升维度无关。一个固定且预计算的原始算子使得仅使用矩阵-向量乘积和投影的高效原始-对偶迭代成为可能，从而无需重新分解即可适应变化的目标和约束。这种效率还通过训练循环中的可微 KC-QP 和批处理 DAgger 风格数据聚合，实现控制感知的动力学学习。μMPC 在桌面 CPU 上实现低至 23 μs 的求解时间，在 168 MHz Crazyflie 微控制器上为 24 ms。它可扩展到 5 ms 以内的 4096D 四足控制、0.4 ms 的 2048D 世界模型视觉规划，以及在 GPU 上以超过 30 Hz 对 200 架四旋翼进行碰撞感知规划。在这些基准中，μMPC 相比竞争方法实现最高 108× 更快的约束 MPC 和 1907× 更快的视觉运动规划。

items.title_en: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
items.title_zh: OS-Omni：跨平台长时程工作流上的通用计算机使用智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone. OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters, trajectory logging, and executable final-state evaluators, and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state. Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps. On v1, the strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches 68.5% average success, trailing the 77.3% human reference by 8.8 points; the gap is uneven across platforms, with frontier models exceeding humans on Linux but trailing them by more than 25 points on iOS and macOS. These results indicate that current agents remain far from platform-robust, long-horizon computer use, especially when success requires sustained state tracking and durable final-state changes.
items.abstract_zh: 计算机使用智能体日益被期望完成真实的用户目标，而不是孤立的GUI操作。然而，现有基准通常隔离Web、移动端或桌面环境，导致不清楚单个通用智能体能否执行跨越多个操作系统和持久应用状态的长时程工作流。我们提出OS-Omni，一个用于在Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android和Web环境中评估计算机使用智能体的实时跨平台基准与执行环境。OS-Omni以每波300个任务的版本化批次发布；本文聚焦首个发布版v1，其包含每个平台48个任务，以及12个将桌面与Android手机配对的跨平台工作流。OS-Omni提供可复现初始化、平台特定适配器、轨迹日志和可执行的最终状态评估器，并包含受控的服务支撑应用，用于涉及账户、购物车、预算、日历、消息和其他持久状态的工作流。人类研究表明，OS-Omni任务需要67.54个交互步骤，显著超过OSWorld参考的15.0步。在v1上，最强被评估智能体Claude Opus 5.5达到68.5%的平均成功率，落后人类参考77.3% 8.8个百分点；这一差距在不同平台间不均衡，前沿模型在Linux上超过人类，但在iOS和macOS上落后人类超过25个百分点。这些结果表明，当前智能体仍远未实现平台鲁棒的长时程计算机使用，尤其是当成功需要持续状态跟踪和持久最终状态变更时。

items.title_en: Lattice models of chiral random motion: A short review
items.title_zh: 手性随机运动的晶格模型：一篇简短综述
items.abstract_en: Chirality, a systematic rotational bias, is ubiquitous in many random motion patterns, from bacteria cells, that swim in circles near surfaces and spinning colloids, to charged particles diffusing under the influence of magnetic fields. In two dimensions, chirality renders random transport \textit{odd}: the diffusion tensor acquires an antisymmetric part that leaves the mean-squared displacement invariant but modifies fluxes and boundary currents. Lattice models for random motion are a natural setting to study chirality, since they are exactly solvable, connect directly to heterogeneous media, cellular automata, and programmable robots, and in discrete time admit fully chiral limits with a localised bulk and edge transport. Lattice walks with a rotational bias have been introduced in different communities several times since 1960, yet without a common language or conceptual connection between them. Here we review these models from the perspective that on the lattice, chirality requires memory. Taking the recently introduced chiral random walk model as a template, we describe the walker with an internal degree of freedom. With a chiral biased updating rule, the full diffusion tensor of this chiral walker turns odd. Within this picture, we can unite persistent and chiral walks, run-and-tumble motion, and cyclic random motions in one framework. We discuss how the memory is followed into the environment; in Lorentz lattice gases, kinetic and rotor walks, and random odd environments; and into the path; in spiral self-avoiding walks.
items.abstract_zh: 手性，即一种系统性旋转偏置，在许多随机运动模式中普遍存在，从在表面附近做圆周游动的细菌细胞和自旋胶体，到在磁场影响下扩散的带电粒子。在二维中，手性使随机输运成为odd（奇）：扩散张量获得一个反对称部分，该部分保持均方位移不变，但改变通量和边界流。随机运动的晶格模型是研究手性的自然框架，因为它们可精确求解，直接连接异质介质、元胞自动机和可编程机器人，并且在离散时间中允许具有局域体输运和边缘输运的完全手性极限。自1960年以来，不同领域多次引入具有旋转偏置的晶格行走，但缺乏共同语言或概念联系。本文从“在晶格上手性需要记忆”的视角综述这些模型。以最近引入的手性随机行走模型为模板，我们用内部自由度描述行走者。在手性偏置更新规则下，该手性行走者的完整扩散张量变为odd（奇）。在这一图景中，我们可以将持久行走与手性行走、run-and-tumble运动以及循环随机运动统一在一个框架中。我们讨论记忆如何进入环境——在洛伦兹晶格气体、动力学行走和转子行走以及随机odd环境中；以及进入路径——在螺旋自回避行走中。

items.title_en: State convertibility in quantum-state texture from a general form of free operations
items.title_zh: 通过谱目标设计缓解RND中的过度泛化
items.abstract_en: State convertibility specifies which transformations between states a quantum resource theory allows. In quantum-state texture, deterministic conversion criteria are known for qubits and pure sources in arbitrary dimension, but a general criterion for mixed states in higher dimensions is missing. We derive this exact criterion from a complete characterization of free operations in arbitrary finite dimension. Because the unique free state is pure, every free operation splits into a quantum filter and a residual completely positive map. Using this decomposition, we show that every allowed conversion admits a two-outcome measurement that retains the filtered state after one outcome and prepares a fixed state after the other. Conversion thus reduces to finding such a filter whose unnormalized output leaves a positive semidefinite remainder when subtracted from the target, a search we show to be solvable by semidefinite programming. Beyond deterministic conversion, the characterization of free operations can be used to study probabilistic and assisted manipulation of quantum-state texture. More broadly, since the construction relies on a pure fixed state, it also applies to other resource theories defined by free operations fixing such a state.
items.abstract_zh: 随机网络蒸馏（RND）是一种用于RL的可扩展新颖性信号，基于固定的随机目标网络和训练过的预测器。然而，它可能过度泛化：预测器将随机目标外推到数据流形之外，导致新颖性分数在陌生输入上崩溃。本文通过核理论视角分析这一失败。在高斯过程目标模型和NTK机制下的预测器下，我们表明RND新颖性分数是一种交叉核残差方差：它由目标协方差核和预测器NTK共同决定，而不是由其中任何一个单独决定。这将过度泛化识别为谱欠激发。受此观点启发，我们将谱目标设计表述为塑造RND新颖性几何的原则。作为一个具体实例，我们用带宽可控的随机傅里叶特征（RFF）目标替换隐式随机网络目标，将残差信号重新分配到被预测器衰减较少的模态。在离线D4RL、在线Atari和Fetch操作基准上的实验表明，新颖性区分度和下游RL性能均得到改善。RL实现的代码可在https://github.com/tuuktuc86/RFF-RND获取。

items.title_en: Mitigating Overgeneralization in RND via Spectral Target Design
items.title_zh: TACT-Bench：测试针对工具使用智能体的自适应对话威胁
items.abstract_en: Random Network Distillation (RND) is a scalable novelty signal for RL based on a fixed random target network and a trained predictor. However, it can overgeneralize: the predictor extrapolates the random target off the data manifold, causing novelty scores to collapse on unfamiliar inputs. This paper analyzes this failure through a kernel-theoretic lens. Under a GP target model and an NTK-regime predictor, we show that the RND novelty score is a cross-kernel residual variance: it is governed jointly by the target covariance kernel and the predictor NTK, rather than by either one alone. This identifies overgeneralization as spectral under-excitation. Motivated by this view, we formulate spectral target design as a principle for shaping RND novelty geometry. As a concrete instance, we replace the implicit random-network target with a bandwidth-controlled Random Fourier Feature (RFF) target, redistributing residual signal toward modes less attenuated by the predictor. Experiments on offline D4RL, online Atari, and Fetch manipulation benchmarks show improved novelty discrimination and downstream RL performance. The code for the RL implementation is available at https://github.com/tuuktuc86/RFF-RND.
items.abstract_zh: AI智能体在使用外部工具和做出决策方面日益增强的自主性，迫切需要一个全面的安全基准。现有基准测试被破坏的工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，但可能无法捕捉受策略约束的工具使用智能体的独特能力：这类智能体必须抵抗未授权请求，同时不放弃同一交互中嵌入的合法工作。为填补这一空白，我们提出TACT-Bench，一个围绕场景特定故事、角色设定、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建的有状态基准。每个对抗任务都针对提供给助手的策略明确禁止的动作，而该策略对攻击用户保持隐藏。TACT为每个对抗任务匹配至少一个良性对应任务，并且当仍存在合规解决方案时，其对抗任务保留授权的真实动作。我们将这些基础任务定义为TACT-Base。我们还提出TACT-TrustPrime，它在同一对话中将一个独立良性任务置于一个无关攻击之前。我们还提出配对选择性可信度（PST），它结合明确的安全拒绝与在匹配良性任务上展示的能力，以分析智能体的过度谨慎和实用性。在作为助手的6个不同模型上平均，TACT-Base相较四个兼容攻击基线将攻击诱导失败率（AFR）提高17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime进一步将其提高17.01%。两种被评估的防御方法平均仅将AFR降低8.35%–9.41%，且不能持续改善PST，这强调了需要更强的策略执行方法。

items.title_en: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 切换有向图下参考模型引导的无人机集群编队飞行分布式MPC
items.abstract_en: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.
items.abstract_zh: 复杂环境中无人机（UAV）集群的分布式编队控制面临若干挑战，包括智能体间连通性切换、有限通信、外部扰动和避碰。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种参考模型引导的无人机集群编队分布式模型预测控制（MPC）框架。每架无人机使用来自邻居的相对位置信息作为局部参考模型的输入，该模型的输出作为机载MPC控制器的编队引导。同时，利用卡尔曼滤波器预测邻近无人机的运动，从而仅根据瞬时相对状态信息构建无人机间避碰约束。通过将MPC优化与分布式协调解耦，该控制架构保留了MPC的前瞻规划和约束处理能力，同时增强了集群对切换有向图的适应性。此外，消除邻居预测轨迹的交换降低了通信带宽需求，为大规模无人机集群提供了强可扩展性。为提高鲁棒性和安全性，采用基于扰动观测器的前馈补偿，同时在基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的避障约束中显式考虑有界残差扰动。最后，通过仿真和真实飞行实验验证了所提框架。具体而言，飞行验证在无外部全局定位的全分布式多无人机平台上进行。

items.title_en: Reference-Model-Guided Distributed MPC for UAV Swarm Formation Flying Under Switching Directed Graphs
items.abstract_en: Distributed formation control of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in complex environments faces several challenges, including switching inter-agent connectivity, limited communication, external disturbances, and collision avoidance. To address these challenges, we propose a reference-model-guided distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework for UAV swarm formation. Each UAV uses relative-position information from its neighbors as input to a local reference model, whose output serves as the formation guidance for the onboard MPC controller. Meanwhile, a Kalman filter is utilized to predict neighboring UAV motions, enabling the construction of inter-UAV collision-avoidance constraints solely from instantaneous relative-state information. By decoupling MPC optimization from distributed coordination, this control architecture preserves the look-ahead planning and constraint-handling capabilities of MPC while enhancing the swarm's adaptability to switching directed graphs. Moreover, eliminating the exchange of neighbors' predicted trajectories reduces communication bandwidth demands, offering strong scalability for large-scale UAV swarms. To improve robustness and safety, disturbance-observer-based feedforward compensation is employed, while the bounded residual disturbance is explicitly considered in the control barrier function (CBF)-based obstacle-avoidance constraints. Finally, the proposed framework is validated through both simulations and real-world flight experiments. Specifically, the flight verification is conducted on a fully distributed multi-UAV platform without external global localization.

items.title_en: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
items.title_zh: 一次跌落揭示了什么：从视频进行可变形物体的仿真到真实材料估计
items.abstract_en: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.
items.abstract_zh: 物体撞击地面时如何变形揭示了它的材质。从单段真实跌落视频中，我们估计可变形物体的密度归一化刚度 E/ρ，以及当冲击导致塑性变形时的屈服应力 σ_Y/ρ，所用前馈预测器仅在仿真中训练。真实视频不带材料标签，因此这类预测器仅基于合成数据开发和验证。我们表明，合成验证对其几何输入的排序是错误的。材料通过 3D 变形起作用，而用估计深度提升到 3D 的轨迹片段在仿真中确实是最准确的输入。然而，在真实跌落中它们却最不准确，更好的深度也无法修复：无论训练中使用仿真器深度、测试时使用 LiDAR 深度，还是在真实跌落的渲染回放上使用精确深度，这种失败都持续存在。短 2D 光流轨迹片段则相反：它们在仿真中没有任何提升，却迁移效果最好。因此，材料更适合从感知在两个域中一致测量的量中读取，而不是从仿真中最具信息量的量中读取。我们的预测器 PhysReader 读取视频和 2D 轨迹片段，并在仿真中通过匹配一个能看到精确 3D 变形的教师模型来学习提升到 3D。为衡量迁移，我们引入 PhysReader-Real：16 个日常物体，每个跌落五次，参考材料参数联合拟合每个物体的各次跌落，并用拉伸试验校验。在 PhysReader-Real 上，PhysReader 比所有其他输入和基线都更接近参考材料。唯一例外是从 PhysReader 预测出发的逐场景优化器，它最终略更接近，但每个视频耗时 49 分钟，而不是 12 秒。

items.title_en: Normative and neural network models of multisensory integration
items.title_zh: 多感觉整合的规范性模型与神经网络模型
items.abstract_en: Animals continuously detect scents, sights and sounds, which their brains combine into diverse multisensory streams. Multisensory integration accelerates learning, increases reaction speeds and helps to resolve sensory ambiguities. In studying this process, the field has developed a continuum of models; from concise mathematical equations, with a handful of variables, to artificial neural networks, with billions of parameters. In this review, we divide this spectrum into two classes: normative models start from a hypothesis about how multisensory signals should be integrated, while neural network models aim to emulate how circuits could integrate them. Together, these models demonstrate that observers can integrate cues in a statistically optimal fashion, and help to explain experimental findings, including the diversity of multisensory neuron response profiles and network architectures. In this review, we provide a didactic overview of multisensory models, complete with accessible equations and Python code, and compare their assumptions and explanatory power. We detail what has been learned from these models. Finally, we discuss how the ideas and insights from classical theoretical models can be reconciled with those from artificial neural networks, and how this convergence should shape future research.
items.abstract_zh: 动物持续检测气味、视觉和声音，大脑将它们组合成多样的多感觉流。多感觉整合加速学习、提高反应速度，并帮助解决感觉模糊性。在研究这一过程时，该领域发展出一系列连续谱系的模型：从只有少量变量的简洁数学方程，到具有数十亿参数的人工神经网络。在本综述中，我们将这一谱系分为两类：规范性模型从关于多感觉信号应如何整合的假设出发，而神经网络模型旨在模拟神经回路如何整合这些信号。这些模型共同表明，观察者能够以统计最优的方式整合线索，并有助于解释实验发现，包括多感觉神经元反应剖面的多样性和网络架构的多样性。在本综述中，我们对多感觉模型进行教学式概述，配有易懂的方程和 Python 代码，并比较其假设和解释力。我们详细说明从这些模型中学到了什么。最后，我们讨论经典理论模型的思想和见解如何与人工神经网络的思想和见解相协调，以及这种趋同应如何塑造未来研究。

items.title_en: Conditional multiparameter thermometry with neutrino oscillations: MSW energy diversity and a plasma-noise benchmark
items.title_zh: 基于中微子振荡的条件多参数测温：MSW 能量多样性与等离子体噪声基准
items.abstract_en: We address temperature-parameter inference in a restricted two-flavor neutrino dephasing model with fixed mean electron densities. When two zone temperatures enter the propagated state via a single accumulated dephasing exponent, the single-energy quantum Fisher information matrix has rank at most 1. Independent, energy-resolved samples restore regular local identifiability when their thermal-sensitivity vectors are noncollinear. Matter-dependent mixing provides distinct weights in an illustrative two-zone model. A separate two-probe benchmark shows how complementary Bell sectors can distinguish temperature from spatial noise correlations. An electron-only Debye-cell estimate gives a conditional longitudinal quantum signal-to-noise ratio of approximately $3.1\times10^{-13}$ at 10 MeV for a uniform central-density medium over one solar radius. This estimate is not a microscopic upper bound or a detector sensitivity forecast. Complete phase averaging removes temperature information carried solely by longitudinal coherence damping; to retain solar sensitivity, a separate calculation of population, refractive, or production effects is required. The results distinguish conditional state identifiability from operational temperature inference.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究在固定平均电子密度的受限两味中微子退相干模型中的温度参数推断。当两个区域温度通过单个累积退相干指数进入传播态时，单能量量子 Fisher 信息矩阵的秩至多为 1。独立的、按能量分辨的样本在其热灵敏度向量不共线时恢复正则局部可辨识性。在示例性双区域模型中，依赖物质的混合提供不同权重。一个单独的双探针基准表明，互补的 Bell 扇区如何将温度与空间噪声关联区分开来。仅电子 Debye 单元估计给出：对于跨越一个太阳半径的均匀中心密度介质，在 10 MeV 时条件纵向量子信噪比约为 3.1×10^-13。该估计不是微观上限，也不是探测器灵敏度预测。完全相位平均会去除仅由纵向相干阻尼携带的温度信息；为保留太阳灵敏度，需要单独计算布居、折射或产生效应。结果将条件状态可辨识性与可操作温度推断区分开来。

items.title_en: Sliding-Window Detection of Hidden Regimes under Stochastic Switching
items.title_zh: 随机切换下隐藏区制的滑动窗口检测
items.abstract_en: A sliding-window average is a simple estimator of the current state of a hidden regime-switching process, such as a hidden Markov model. A longer window averages out more noise but is more likely to contain a switch, and the question is what such a switch costs. We analyse the decoder that assigns the average of the last $m$ observations to the nearest regime mean. For two regimes with conditionally independent, stochastically ordered observations, a switch inside the window, averaged uniformly over its positions and directions, causes an error with probability exactly $1/2$. Consequently, for every stationary switching law, the error is at most $\bar P(m)+\bar s(m-1)/2$, where $\bar P(m)$ is the stationary-weighted single-regime error and $\bar s$ the switch rate. Under Markov switching, time reversal shows that a window whose oldest and current regimes differ is misclassified with probability exactly $1/2$, however many switches it contains, and the bound is attained up to a factor $p_{\min}^{m-1}$. For Gaussian noise with common variance, minimizing the bound gives an explicit window length which, in units of $σ^2/Δ^2$, depends only on the expected number of switches in that time. As switching probabilities vanish proportionally, the optimal error is $\bar s\log(1/\bar s)/(2I)(1+o(1))$, with $I$ the single-regime Chernoff exponent. In the Gaussian case this is twice the Bayes error. For symmetric switching, exponentially weighted moving averages reduce this factor to at most $2\log2\approx1.39$, and two-block weights adapted to the switch rate attain the Bayes rate. For three or more regimes, long-window switch costs are set by the geometry of the regime means. For Markov-modulated random walks with $\pm1$ steps on a reflecting lattice, a position-aware decoder learns as fast as without walls under holding boundaries, while steps at bouncing boundaries carry none.
items.abstract_zh: 滑动窗口平均是隐藏区制切换过程（如隐马尔可夫模型）当前状态的简单估计器。更长的窗口能平均掉更多噪声，但更可能包含一次切换，问题在于这种切换的代价是什么。我们分析将最近 m 个观测的平均值分配给最近区制均值的解码器。对于具有条件独立、随机序观测的两个区制，窗口内的一次切换在其位置和方向上均匀平均后，导致错误的概率恰好为 1/2。因此，对于每个平稳切换律，错误率至多为 \bar P(m)+\bar s(m-1)/2，其中 \bar P(m) 是平稳加权的单区制错误，\bar s 是切换率。在马尔可夫切换下，时间反转表明，最旧区制与当前区制不同的窗口被误分类的概率恰好为 1/2，无论其中包含多少次切换，且该界可达到，至多相差一个因子 p_min^{m-1}。对于具有共同方差的高斯噪声，最小化该界给出显式窗口长度，其以 σ^2/Δ^2 为单位时仅取决于该时间内的期望切换次数。当切换概率按比例趋于零时，最优误差为 \bar s\log(1/\bar s)/(2I)(1+o(1))，其中 I 是单区制 Chernoff 指数。在高斯情形下，这是 Bayes 错误的两倍。对于对称切换，指数加权移动平均将该因子降至至多 2\log2≈1.39，而适应切换率的双块权重可达到 Bayes 率。对于三个或更多区制，长窗口切换代价由区制均值的几何结构决定。对于在反射格点上具有 ±1 步长的马尔可夫调制随机游走，在保持边界下，位置感知解码器的学习速度与无墙时一样快，而在反弹边界处的步长不携带任何信息。

items.title_en: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
items.title_zh: Tablassert：从生物医学表格中声明式提取知识图谱
items.abstract_en: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学研究论文中发表的表格，尤其是补充表格，捕获了可能因多种原因而未出现在稿件正文中的知识断言，这些原因包括统计显著性低、篇幅限制和叙述范围。这些表格包含编码生物实体之间关系的数据（例如关联统计量、检测读数、精选基因列表和组学数据）。Tablassert 将此类表格数据（Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet）转换为可供 NCATS Biomedical Data Translator 使用的知识图谱（Fecho 等，2025）。用户在 YAML 中声明每个表格的数据如何映射为主语-谓语-宾语-限定符语句；Tablassert 将自由文本（例如“肺癌”）解析为标准标识符，附加来源和统计信息，并输出符合 Translator 标准的图文件（D. Unni、Bruskiewich 和 Moxon 2026；D. R. Unni 等，2022）。

items.title_en: AGLR: Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement for Fine-Grained Humanoid Motion Generation and Editing
items.title_zh: AGLR：面向细粒度人形运动生成与编辑的属性引导潜在精炼
items.abstract_en: Humanoid motion generation must accommodate evolving task requirements, where localized adjustments should satisfy new geometric constraints without disrupting desired motion details. However, language-based control lacks geometric precision, while joint-level constraints require explicit spatial targets. Local geometric constraints are also underdetermined, complicating target satisfaction and source preservation. We present AGLR (Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement), a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing through source-anchored refinement. A compact geometric interface supports composable, time-varying control of limb extents, torso orientation, and root trajectories. Given a generated or encoded base latent, an Attribute Residual Adapter predicts a single-pass correction, with dual-level supervision enforcing target matching and selective preservation across attributes and motion coordinates. On HumanML3D-G1, AGLR achieves the highest controllable-generation and preservation-constrained editing success rates among evaluated methods. Editing take only 9.1 ms for a cached 500-frame motion, without additional sampling or test-time optimization. Zero-shot evaluation on BONES-SEED-G1 further demonstrates transfer without fine-tuning.
items.abstract_zh: 人形运动生成必须适应不断变化的任务需求，其中局部调整应满足新的几何约束，同时不破坏期望的运动细节。然而，基于语言的控制缺乏几何精度，而关节级约束需要显式空间目标。局部几何约束还是欠定的，使目标满足和源保持变得复杂。我们提出 AGLR（属性引导潜在精炼），一个通过源锚定精炼实现细粒度人形运动生成与编辑的统一框架。一个紧凑的几何接口支持对肢体范围、躯干朝向和根轨迹进行可组合、时变的控制。给定生成或编码的基础潜在表示，属性残差适配器预测单次通过的校正，并采用双层监督，在属性和运动坐标上强制执行目标匹配和选择性保持。在 HumanML3D-G1 上，AGLR 在所评估方法中取得最高的可控生成成功率和保持约束编辑成功率。对于缓存的 500 帧运动，编辑仅需 9.1 毫秒，无需额外采样或测试时优化。在 BONES-SEED-G1 上的零样本评估进一步证明无需微调即可迁移。

items.title_en: TIDE-Flow: Fine-Grained Temporal Evidence and Structured Displacement Matching for Spike Optical Flow
items.title_zh: TIDE-Flow：用于脉冲光流的细粒度时间证据与结构化位移匹配
items.abstract_en: Spike cameras capture high-speed motion through an integrate-and-fire mechanism, providing fine-grained temporal observations without exposure blur. However, their binary streams encode accumulated illumination rather than instantaneous intensity, making reliable motion estimation challenging. Existing spike-based methods exploit temporal aggregation to construct motion representations, but this process may weaken fine-grained firing patterns. Meanwhile, correlation-based estimators often rely on learned matching features without explicitly characterizing the spatial distribution and ambiguity of candidate displacements. To address these challenges, we propose TIDE-Flow, a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that jointly exploits Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) and Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE). TIE combines raw spike patterns, multi-scale firing statistics, temporal moments, and boundary-aware interval cues, preserving complementary temporal information before spatial feature compression. DEE further integrates structured candidate-grid features with explicit displacement statistics to characterize matching geometry and competing correspondences. Both components are incorporated into a difference-correlation recurrent refinement framework, enabling effective temporal motion modeling and correspondence estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TIDE-Flow, with controlled ablations validating the contributions of temporal and displacement evidence modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 脉冲相机通过积分-发放机制捕捉高速运动，提供无曝光模糊的细粒度时间观测。然而，其二进制流编码的是累积光照而非瞬时强度，这使得可靠的运动估计具有挑战性。现有的基于脉冲的方法利用时间聚合来构建运动表示，但这一过程可能削弱细粒度的发放模式。同时，基于相关性的估计器通常依赖学习到的匹配特征，而未显式刻画候选位移的空间分布与歧义性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TIDE-Flow，一种基于脉冲的光流估计框架，联合利用时间积分证据（TIE）和位移证据编码（DEE）。TIE 结合原始脉冲模式、多尺度发放统计、时间矩和边界感知的区间线索，在空间特征压缩之前保留互补的时间信息。DEE 进一步将结构化候选网格特征与显式位移统计相结合，以刻画匹配几何与竞争对应关系。两个组件均被纳入差分相关循环细化框架，从而实现有效的时间运动建模与对应估计。大量实验证明了 TIDE-Flow 的有效性，受控消融实验验证了时间证据建模和位移证据建模的贡献。

items.title_en: Accuracy of Noise Ceiling Estimators for Brain Scores
items.title_zh: 脑分数噪声天花板估计器的准确性
items.abstract_en: The internal activations of modern machine learning models align surprisingly well with the activities recorded in real brains. In the last five years, the alignment between encoding models and brain activities, often called brain scores, has steadily increased. Because brain recordings are noisy, there exists an upper bound to the brain scores that any model can achieve. This bound, called the noise ceiling, is crucial for two reasons: it determines whether further improvements in model performance are possible, and it enables meaningful comparisons of brain scores across benchmarks. The field has developed multiple approaches to estimate noise ceilings, but the statistical properties of existing estimators remain poorly understood, leaving it unclear in which experimental settings they provide reliable estimates. Here, we introduce a unified mathematical framework for brain recordings, use it to derive closed-form expressions for four commonly used noise ceiling estimators, and provide theoretical predictions for the behavior of each estimator. We validate the theoretical predictions with simulations that we compare to noise ceiling estimates in existing fMRI and EEG datasets. We find that the existing methods underestimate the true noise ceiling in different settings. We conclude with recommendations for best practice in different situations.
items.abstract_zh: 现代机器学习模型的内部激活与真实大脑中记录的活动惊人地吻合。在过去五年中，编码模型与大脑活动之间的一致性（常称为脑分数）稳步提高。由于大脑记录存在噪声，任何模型所能达到的脑分数存在一个上界。这一上界称为噪声天花板，其重要性体现在两个方面：它决定了模型性能是否还有进一步提升的可能，并使跨基准的脑分数比较具有意义。该领域已发展出多种估计噪声天花板的方法，但现有估计器的统计性质仍知之甚少，导致尚不清楚它们在哪些实验设置下能提供可靠估计。在此，我们引入一个用于大脑记录的统一数学框架，利用其为四种常用噪声天花板估计器推导闭式表达式，并为每种估计器的行为提供理论预测。我们通过模拟验证理论预测，并将模拟结果与现有 fMRI 和 EEG 数据集中的噪声天花板估计进行比较。我们发现，现有方法在不同设置下均低估了真实噪声天花板。最后，我们针对不同情形给出最佳实践建议。

items.title_en: Tunable Terahertz Bandpass Filter based on the Photonic Emulation of a 2DEG Interferometer through the Geometric Phase of Light
items.title_zh: 基于光几何相位对 2DEG 干涉仪进行光子模拟的可调谐太赫兹带通滤波器
items.abstract_en: Terahertz frequencies are expected to become a key player in next-generation wireless communications. For this transition to occur seamlessly, tunable bandpass filters for channel selection are essential. However, conventional Fabry-Pérot cavity-based bandpass filters face inherent limitations. Specifically, their tunability is restricted by physical constraints, such as the maximum achievable mirror separation. In this work, drawing inspiration from electronic interferometers, we demonstrate a continuously tunable bandpass filter operating near 0.3 THz by exploiting the geometric phase of light, the Pancharatnam-Berry phase. Our device incorporates intracavity waveplates for polarization control and is described by a mathematical expression analogous to that of the electronic interferometer governed by the Aharonov-Bohm phase, thereby realizing a photonic analogue. Using custom-designed subwavelength waveplates and cavity mirrors, we achieve a finesse of $\mathcal{F}\approx17$, a quality factor of $Q\approx1.5\times10^{3}$, and a resonance linewidth of $Δf_{\mathrm{FWHM}}\approx 200$ MHz. Beyond terahertz communication technology, this system is expected to find applications in fields requiring high frequency resolution, such as spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 太赫兹频率有望在下一代无线通信中发挥关键作用。为实现无缝过渡，用于信道选择的可调谐带通滤波器至关重要。然而，传统的基于法布里-珀罗腔的带通滤波器面临固有局限。具体而言，其可调谐性受到物理约束的限制，例如可实现的镜面最大间距。在本工作中，受电子干涉仪启发，我们利用光的几何相位——Pancharatnam-Berry 相位，演示了一种工作在约 0.3 THz 的连续可调谐带通滤波器。我们的器件在腔内集成波片以进行偏振控制，并由一个与受 Aharonov-Bohm 相位支配的电子干涉仪类似的数学表达式描述，从而实现光子模拟。使用定制设计的亚波长波片和腔镜，我们实现了 F≈17 的精细度、Q≈1.5×10^3 的品质因子以及 Δf_FWHM≈200 MHz 的谐振线宽。除太赫兹通信技术外，该系统有望应用于需要高频率分辨率的领域，如光谱学。

items.title_en: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
items.title_zh: 并非所有世界模型都能怀疑：训练目标与架构如何塑造 JEPA 和 RSSM 世界模型中的认知不确定性
items.abstract_en: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. Executed actions, or decisions, taken in this manner are only as reliable as the model's predictive capabilities, and predictions in turn are only reliable within the model's experience. Epistemic uncertainty (EU) is the signal that marks where that experience ends. In this work we offer an extensive empirical study on how training objectives and architectures shape epistemic uncertainty of world models. More precisely, we present a controlled comparison of post-hoc EU (last-layer Laplace and ensembles) between two dominant models of different paradigms: 1) LeWorldModel (LeWM): A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), which predicts the next embedding without a decoder, and 2) DreamerV3: A recurrent state-space model (RSSM), which reconstructs the observation from a recurrent latent state. In ten simulated visual-control environments, we follow a controlled state perturbation of the environment state through every stage of the models up to the final EU estimate. We find that the RSSM attenuates the state perturbation through two mechanisms before it reaches an estimator on the predictor feature. Its recurrent update averages over context, so a change in a single frame reaches the state at a fraction of its size and recovers only as the change persists. Its reconstruction objective weights an entity by the pixels it covers, so a small object can be lost due to the training objective. The JEPA has neither mechanism and passes the change through all stages to the uncertainty. We further show that this translates to gaps in five uncertainty related downstream tasks, from unfamiliar-state detection to uncertainty-penalised planning: the RSSM uncertainty misses deviations that its own posterior registers, whereas the JEPA uncertainty reports what its model sees.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型预测环境对动作的响应，从而可在执行前评估候选动作。以这种方式执行的动作或决策，其可靠性取决于模型的预测能力，而预测又仅在模型的经验范围内可靠。认知不确定性（EU）是标记该经验范围边界的信号。在本工作中，我们开展广泛的实证研究，探讨训练目标与架构如何塑造世界模型的认知不确定性。更准确地说，我们对两种不同范式的主流模型进行事后 EU（最后一层 Laplace 和集成）的受控比较：1）LeWorldModel（LeWM）：一种联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），在没有解码器的情况下预测下一嵌入；2）DreamerV3：一种循环状态空间模型（RSSM），从循环潜状态重建观测。在十个模拟视觉控制环境中，我们追踪对环境状态施加的受控状态扰动，贯穿模型各个阶段直至最终 EU 估计。我们发现，RSSM 在扰动到达预测器特征上的估计器之前，通过两种机制衰减状态扰动。其循环更新对上下文进行平均，因此单帧变化以原幅度的一小部分到达状态，并且只有在变化持续时才会恢复。其重建目标按实体覆盖的像素对其加权，因此小物体可能因训练目标而丢失。JEPA 不具备这两种机制，会将变化贯穿所有阶段传递至不确定性。我们进一步表明，这会导致五个与不确定性相关的下游任务出现差距，从不熟悉状态检测到不确定性惩罚规划：RSSM 的不确定性遗漏了其自身后验所记录的偏差，而 JEPA 的不确定性则报告其模型所看到的内容。

items.title_en: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
items.title_zh: 迷失于翻译，而非置信度：多语言决策模型的基准测试与校准
items.abstract_en: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English. We evaluate 25 top-ranked open-weight decision models on 17 tasks in 14 languages, comparing each language with English on parallel items. Every model loses accuracy in every language, from about 2 points in high-resource languages to 8 in Tamil, while confidence falls only half as much: a threshold set for 95\% accuracy in English yields 90% in Tamil. The size of the loss is set by the language and the base model rather than by leaderboard rank. In 81 controlled fine-tuning runs, task skill learned in English transfers to other languages and a few thousand target-language items narrow large losses, but neither more data nor full-parameter tuning closes them. Finally, the same test items are answered more accurately in all 23 benchmark--language pairs we compare when an LLM rather than a person translated them, so LLM-translated test sets understate the gap.
items.abstract_zh: 决策模型是经微调的语言模型，用于为类型化查询的每个选项返回概率，路由器和护栏直接对其设定阈值。它们构建于多语言基础模型之上，但几乎完全以英语进行排名。我们在 14 种语言的 17 项任务上评估 25 个排名最高的开放权重决策模型，并在平行项目上将每种语言与英语进行比较。每个模型在每种语言中都会损失准确率，从高资源语言中约 2 个百分点到泰米尔语中的 8 个百分点，而置信度下降幅度仅为其一半：为英语设定的 95% 准确率阈值在泰米尔语中仅得到 90%。损失的大小由语言和基础模型决定，而非由排行榜排名决定。在 81 次受控微调运行中，以英语学习到的任务技能可迁移到其他语言，且几千条目标语言项目可缩小较大损失，但更多数据或全参数微调均无法消除这些损失。最后，在我们比较的全部 23 个基准-语言对中，当由 LLM 而非人工翻译时，相同测试项目被回答得更准确，因此 LLM 翻译的测试集低估了这一差距。

items.title_en: Calibration of Neuromusculoskeletal Models Using Differentiable Physics: Recommendations for Improving Model Accuracy
items.title_zh: 使用可微物理校准神经肌肉骨骼模型：提高模型准确性的建议
items.abstract_en: Differentiable physics has shown potential to usher in a new paradigm in human neuromusculoskeletal (NMS) model calibration. Early results from pioneering works have demonstrated that auto-differentiable NMS models can greatly reduce NMS model calibration time while achieving comparable accuracy compared to traditional calibration methods. The efficient gradient-based optimizers have enabled calibration of increasingly sophisticated human models with a large number of parameters, which seek to narrow the gap between simulation and reality. Several modules have been evaluated separately in different studies, but have never been directly compared within the same study. In this work, these modules are compared on the same differentiable upper limb model with a 3-DoF shoulder, a 2-DoF elbow, and 11 superficial and 5 deep muscles in the calibration to find an optimal pipeline for improving model accuracy. The considered modules include muscle synergy, learnable bone parameters, optimizable geometry of wrap objects, and constraint torque of the differentiable arm model. To evaluate the effect and interplay between the modules on calibration accuracy, one or more modules were used in each of 16 calibration configurations, which were compared in terms of the error between two joint torques calculated by the forward and inverse dynamics with the calibrated model on 9 distinctive testing movements across 4 subjects. Results showed that torque loss was reduced by 23.6% on average using muscle synergy extrapolation to estimate deep muscle activities, and by 10.9% on average through bone dynamic parameter optimization, which are both recommended to be incorporated in the calibration.
items.abstract_zh: 可微物理已显示出引领人类神经肌肉骨骼（NMS）模型校准新范式的潜力。开创性工作的早期结果表明，自动可微 NMS 模型可大幅减少 NMS 模型校准时间，同时达到与传统校准方法相当的准确性。高效的基于梯度的优化器使得对具有大量参数的日益复杂的人体模型进行校准成为可能，这些模型旨在缩小仿真与现实之间的差距。若干模块已在不同研究中分别评估，但从未在同一研究中进行直接比较。在本工作中，为寻找提高模型准确性的最优流程，在同一个具有 3 自由度肩、2 自由度肘以及 11 块浅层肌和 5 块深层肌的可微上肢模型上，对这些模块在校准中进行比较。所考虑的模块包括肌肉协同、可学习的骨骼参数、可优化的包裹体几何以及可微手臂模型的约束力矩。为评估各模块对校准准确性的影响及其相互作用，在 16 种校准配置中每种配置使用一个或多个模块，并在 4 名受试者的 9 种不同测试动作上，以校准模型通过正向和逆向动力学计算的两个关节力矩之间的误差进行比较。结果表明，使用肌肉协同外推估计深层肌肉活动可使力矩损失平均降低 23.6%，通过骨骼动力学参数优化可使力矩损失平均降低 10.9%，二者均建议纳入校准。

items.title_en: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
items.title_zh: DDxBasis：通过精确鉴别诊断解释基于冻结基础编码器的医学分类
items.abstract_en: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.
items.abstract_zh: 在鉴别诊断（DDx）中，临床医生通过少数几个将诊断与备选诊断区分开的发现来解释诊断。医学图像分类器尚不能以这种方式自我解释。现有解释要么是忠实的，但分散在数百个概念上；要么是紧凑的，但每次决策都有一部分未被解释。我们提出 DDxBasis，它在三个步骤中将冻结基础编码器上的分类器解释为鉴别诊断。首先，概念瓶颈使用门控二阶槽注意力（gated second-order slot attention）读取每个编码器层的所有 patch token。然后，概念基（concept basis）将概念重组为双极轴，每个轴是诊断组之间的一个差异。最后，我们通过各极的典型表现、病例的相关发现以及边界病例的反事实编辑，从每个轴读出鉴别诊断。在五个医学数据集上，DDxBasis 是最准确的冻结编码器模型，并接近已发表的最佳领域专用结果。由于每个概念都添加自己的证据，其可复现的概念基精确地拆分每次决策，且不以准确率为代价。在没有有序阶段或概念标签的情况下，这些轴恢复出细胞谱系和罕见亚型，与皮肤科医生的结构注释一致，并揭示出植入的和真实的捷径。

items.title_en: A Description-Derived Drug-Drug Interaction Benchmark Reveals Split-Dependent Molecular Representation Rankings
items.title_zh: 一个由描述衍生的药物-药物相互作用基准揭示依赖数据划分的分子表示排序
items.abstract_en: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is clinically important and poses a distinct challenge for molecular representation learning. Unlike single-molecule property prediction, DDI requires a predictor to compose two molecular representations into a relational outcome. DrugBank provides curator-authored DDI descriptions rather than ready-made categorical labels, so a categorical prediction target must first be derived from the text. We construct a dataset of DDI pairs by mapping processed descriptions to six text-derived categories and define a benchmark with four holdout regimes that restrict train-test chemical overlap from random pairs to scaffold-disjoint evaluation. We then use this benchmark to compare molecular fingerprints, pretrained sequence representations, and graph-derived features across five seeds and multiple classifier heads. Molecular fingerprints lead the high- overlap random split, whereas graph-derived representations lead the drug- and scaffold-holdout regimes, with the gap increasing as molecular overlap is restricted. Changing the classifier head affects absolute performance but not the relative representation ranking. These results show that representation rankings change with test-set novelty under a fixed description-derived label space.
items.abstract_zh: 药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测在临床上很重要，并对分子表示学习构成独特挑战。与单分子性质预测不同，DDI 要求预测器将两个分子表示组合成一个关系性结果。DrugBank 提供的是策展人撰写的 DDI 描述而非现成的类别标签，因此必须首先从文本中导出类别预测目标。我们通过将处理后的描述映射到六个文本衍生类别来构建 DDI 对数据集，并定义一个包含四种留出机制的基准，这些机制将训练-测试化学重叠从随机对限制到骨架不相交评估。然后，我们使用该基准在五个随机种子和多种分类器头上比较分子指纹、预训练序列表示和由图导出的特征。分子指纹在高重叠随机划分中领先，而图导出表示在药物留出和骨架留出机制中领先，且随着分子重叠受到限制，差距增大。改变分类器头会影响绝对性能，但不影响相对表示排序。这些结果表明，在固定的描述衍生标签空间下，表示排序会随测试集的新颖性而变化。

items.title_en: Why do single photons produce interference fringes? The phase of a mode and the phase of a state
items.title_zh: 为什么单光子会产生干涉条纹？模式的相位与状态的相位
items.abstract_en: If the phase of a photon-number state is completely undetermined, how can single photons, sent one at a time through a two-slit apparatus, build up interference fringes? These lecture notes answer this question from first principles. Starting from Maxwell's equations, we expand the field in vector modes, quantize it, and introduce the quantity measured by a photodetector. We then show that the word ``phase'' refers to two different things: the phase of a mode, fixed by the optical setup, and the phase of the quantum state that excites the mode. Only the first determines the fringes. All calculations are given in full, and problems with solutions are included.
items.abstract_zh: 如果光子数态的相位完全未确定，那么单个光子逐个通过双缝装置时，如何能累积形成干涉条纹？这些讲义从第一性原理回答这一问题。从麦克斯韦方程组出发，我们将场展开为矢量模式，对其进行量子化，并引入光电探测器所测量的量。随后我们表明，“相位”一词指代两种不同的事物：模式的相位，由光学装置固定；以及激发该模式的量子态的相位。只有前者决定条纹。所有计算均完整给出，并附有习题及解答。

items.title_en: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
items.title_zh: 路由之前先审可路由性：面向经审计的 LLM 模型选择的可路由性审计协议（RAP）与 RouteabilityBench
items.abstract_en: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently outperform the single best model. The clearest positive evidence is concentrated in portfolio-dependent Omni-MATH settings, while GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval show different ways in which routing can remain hard or predictor-sensitive. Our practical recommendation is that routing gains should be reported together with routeability diagnostics, tied-best analysis, portfolio construction details, and family-corrected statistical tests.
items.abstract_zh: LLM 路由旨在为每个提示选择模型组合中最有可能正确回答的模型。只有当基准包含足够的提示特定变化、使不同模型能在不同输入上表现最佳时，这才有意义。然而，在粗粒度评分的 LLM 基准上，许多模型常常并列最高分，而单一最佳模型可能已经几乎没有改进空间。因此我们提出一种可路由性优先的审计，并具体实现为 RAP 和 RouteabilityBench，一个可运行的断言验证包。该审计是回顾性的：它在基准-组合得分矩阵存在之后、且在将路由比较解释为一般性证据之前运行一次，而不是对尚未评估的模型组合进行认证。在四个基准和 66 个 LLM 上，诸如更大嵌入集、降维、选择性弃答、聚类和更强回归器等通用路由增强并不一致地优于单一最佳模型。最明确的正面证据集中在依赖组合的 Omni-MATH 设置中，而 GPQA、MMLU-Pro 和 IFEval 则展示了路由仍然困难或对预测器敏感的不同方式。我们的实用建议是，路由增益应与可路由性诊断、并列最佳分析、组合构建细节以及族校正统计检验一起报告。

items.title_en: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
items.title_zh: AIChipBench：面向自动化 AI 加速器设计的 LLM 智能体基准
items.abstract_en: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型解码器在解码步骤之间携带状态，而在硬件中，一次错误的状态更新可能使当前 token 仍然正确，却在数个 token 之后破坏输出，因此一个设计可以通过输出测试却仍然是错误的。AIChipBench 追问 LLM 编码智能体需要什么才能正确构建此类硬件。智能体用可综合的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码实现量化的 Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4 和 Llama 3.2 解码器，对照一个可执行的整数参考实现，该参考规定每个解码步骤的输出与所存储状态。它们在固定预算下针对公开测试进行调试；其冻结的设计在留出的 token 序列、复位、存储器停顿和综合上评分，第二个赛道要求它们在面积几乎固定的条件下加速一个正确的设计。在四个编码智能体的 9,136 次尝试中，难点在于所存储的状态。在一项匹配研究中，指向首个状态不匹配的反馈在全部 12 个智能体—任务单元中相较仅输出反馈提高了接受率，提高幅度为 25.0 至 46.9 个百分点，并将每个被接受设计所需的智能体小时数减半。在新的序列和条件下重新评分，69 个被接受设计中有 45 个在其测试所需的 32 步内失败。超过三分之一的加速正确设计的尝试最终没有产出加速设计。总评分将 Sol 5.6 和 Fable 5.1 排在 Astra 6 和 Opus 5.5 之上，且在全部 200 次随机划分中，实例的两个半部分都给出这一顺序。因此，硬件智能体需要能暴露所存储状态的调试反馈，其基准也需要远超开发用例的最终测试。

items.title_en: QK-Bench: Benchmarking Quantitative Kinematic Understanding for Dynamic Spatial Intelligence
items.title_zh: QK-Bench：面向动态空间智能的定量运动学理解基准
items.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence concerns both scene structure and its temporal evolution. Yet a semantically correct description can conceal a quantitative error: recognizing that objects are approaching does not determine their closing speed or whether they will meet. Such errors are critical in collision avoidance, trajectory tracking, and reactive grasping, where actions depend on motion magnitude, timing, and relative geometry. We study quantitative kinematic understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs): resolving motion magnitude, rate, reference-frame dependence, and future spatial evolution from visual evidence. We introduce the Quantitative Kinematics Benchmark (QK-Bench), comprising 2,341 multiple-choice QA pairs from 379 videos and 17 tasks spanning Object-Centric Kinematics, Camera Ego-Motion Kinematics, and Multi-Object Kinematic Relations. Hidden geometric and temporal signals support trajectory construction and filtering, while fixed kinematic rules map physical quantities to verifiable answers, including categorical labels. Trajectory and question validation ensure target reliability and sufficient visual support in the sampled frames. All models receive a unified monocular RGB input. Evaluations of proprietary, open-source, and spatial MLLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model achieves only 41.2\% overall accuracy, and spatial MLLMs show no consistent advantage. These findings indicate that current advances in spatial intelligence do not reliably transfer to quantitative kinematic understanding.
items.abstract_zh: 空间智能既涉及场景结构，也涉及其时间演化。然而，语义上正确的描述可能掩盖定量错误：识别出物体正在接近，并不能确定它们的接近速度或是否会相遇。此类错误在碰撞避免、轨迹跟踪和反应式抓取中至关重要，因为这些行动取决于运动幅度、时序和相对几何。我们研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的定量运动学理解：从视觉证据中解析运动幅度、速率、参考系依赖性以及未来空间演化。我们提出定量运动学基准（QK-Bench），包含来自 379 个视频的 2,341 个多项选择问答对和 17 项任务，涵盖以物体为中心的运动学、相机自我运动运动学和多物体运动学关系。隐藏的几何与时间信号支持轨迹构建和筛选，固定的运动学规则将物理量映射为可验证的答案，包括类别标签。轨迹和问题验证确保目标可靠性以及采样帧中的充分视觉支持。所有模型接收统一的单目 RGB 输入。对专有、开源和空间 MLLM 的评估揭示了显著局限：最强模型仅达到 41.2% 的整体准确率，而空间 MLLM 未显示出一致优势。这些发现表明，当前空间智能的进展并不能可靠地迁移到定量运动学理解。

items.title_en: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
items.title_zh: LayoutRecall：在多轮3D布局控制图像编辑中保持外观
items.abstract_en: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 3D布局控制的图像编辑使用户能够显式控制对象放置和相机视角。然而，在一系列编辑中，当对象被遮挡或离开视野时，最新图像可能会丢失该对象的外观。目标布局指定对象应重新出现的位置，而其外观必须从先前的观测中恢复。我们提出LayoutRecall，一种多轮编辑器，在3D框的局部坐标系中存储并重用外观。Box-Surface Latent Memory将图像潜变量保留在框表面上，并沿目标视图中的射线检索它们。Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning使用目标视图位置、共享的框局部嵌入和逐对象注意力，将检索到的token提供给FLUX.2编辑器。对应损失鼓励编辑器在去噪期间关注匹配的观测。我们还引入LayoutLoop，一个具有校准布局和设计重访的多轮3D布局控制图像编辑基准。我们在LayoutLoop和真实场景数据上进行了大量实验，以验证我们方法的能力。项目页面位于 https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/。

items.title_en: The Self-Assembling Brain: Emergent Routing and Its Open Challenges
items.title_zh: 自组装大脑：涌现路由及其开放挑战
items.abstract_en: Biologically inspired alternatives to backpropagation, such as feedback alignment, relax the requirement for exact synaptic weight symmetry but still presuppose a fixed, pre-wired correspondence between forward and feedback pathways, an impasse Liao et al. (PNAS, 2026) term "architectural circularity." This commentary examines their Self-Assembling Motif (SAM), which reframes credit assignment as a self-organizing process driven by local synaptic rules. By linking ascending inference and descending feedback streams through initially random cross-stream connections, SAM supports local bridge alignment and emergent pathway alignment during stable training without fixed neuron-to-neuron pairing. Its resulting learning dynamics also exhibit adaptive preconditioning. The commentary highlights the algorithmic, biophysical, and temporal challenges that define the next research frontier: loss of neuron-specific nonlinear gating under straight-through approximation, compounding routing errors in deeper hierarchies, low-dimensional routing bottlenecks, the cortical implementation of non-driving modulatory connections, and the shift from alternating inference-update phases to continuous sensory processing.
items.abstract_zh: 受生物学启发的反向传播替代方案（如反馈对齐）放宽了对精确突触权重对称性的要求，但仍预设前向与反馈通路之间存在固定的、预连接的对应关系；Liao等人（PNAS，2026）将这一僵局称为“架构循环性”。本评论考察其自组装基元（Self-Assembling Motif, SAM），该方法将信用分配重新表述为由局部突触规则驱动的自组织过程。SAM通过最初随机的跨流连接将上升的推理流与下降的反馈流联系起来，在稳定训练期间支持局部桥接对齐和涌现的通路对齐，而无需固定的神经元到神经元配对。由此产生的学习动力学还表现出自适应预条件。本评论强调了界定下一研究前沿的算法、生物物理和时间挑战：直通近似下神经元特定非线性门控的丧失、更深层次中路由误差的累积、低维路由瓶颈、非驱动性调制连接的皮层实现，以及从交替的推理-更新阶段向连续感觉处理的转变。

items.title_en: Reducing T gates in product formulas with agent loops
items.title_zh: 利用智能体循环减少乘积公式中的T门
items.abstract_en: Quantum chemistry calculations on a fault-tolerant quantum computer usually require many $\text{T}$ gates. This cost depends on the simulation method and how precisely its rotations are implemented. In this paper, we used Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a large language model (LLM), in a coding-agent loop to optimize the structure and rotation-synthesis precision of product formulas (PFs) for quantum phase estimation (QPE). Each of five independent searches optimized a shared protocol across 115 HamLib molecular Hamiltonians spanning 4--16 qubits over 100 code mutations. The searches started from a calibrated, nested second-order PF with uniform synthesis precision. We minimized $T_{95}$, the estimated total $\text{T}$-gate cost including QPE queries and repeated attempts for $95\%$ success probability, while requiring chemical accuracy for every training Hamiltonian. We name the best protocol found error-limited optimized Trotter evolution (ELOTE). It achieves chemical accuracy for its training data and achieved median and geometric-mean $T_{95}$ reductions of $85.35\%$ and $84.82\%$, respectively. ELOTE combines contributions to the same Pauli string, uses a first-order PF, and varies synthesis precision with coefficient magnitude, Pauli support, and diagonal character. We also tested ELOTE on 76 larger Hamiltonians with 18--22 qubits, which met chemical accuracy in every case. For ten reaction energies, we further optimized a shared $δ$-ELOTE protocol. It reduced geometric-mean $T_{95}$ by $58.90\%$ relative to ELOTE while preserving chemical accuracy for every signed reaction difference. These classically verified results show cost savings from shared protocols across molecules and reactions, and motivate similar searches in which energy measurements from quantum computers guide explorations in a coding-agent loop.
items.abstract_zh: 在容错量子计算机上进行量子化学计算通常需要许多$\text{T}$门。这一代价取决于模拟方法及其旋转实现的精确程度。在本文中，我们在编码智能体循环中使用大语言模型（LLM）Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，来优化用于量子相位估计（QPE）的乘积公式（PFs）的结构和旋转合成精度。五次独立搜索中的每一次都在115个HamLib分子哈密顿量（跨越4--16个量子比特）上，通过100次代码变异优化一个共享协议。搜索从经过校准、采用均匀合成精度的嵌套二阶PF开始。我们最小化$T_{95}$，即包括QPE查询以及为达到95\%成功概率而重复尝试的估计总$\text{T}$门成本，同时要求每个训练哈密顿量都达到化学精度。我们将找到的最佳协议命名为误差受限优化Trotter演化（ELOTE）。它在训练数据上达到化学精度，并分别实现了$T_{95}$中位数和几何平均降低$85.35\%$和$84.82\%$。ELOTE合并对同一Pauli串的贡献，使用一阶PF，并随系数幅度、Pauli支撑和对角特征改变合成精度。我们还在76个具有18--22个量子比特的更大哈密顿量上测试了ELOTE，每个案例都达到了化学精度。对于十个反应能量，我们进一步优化了一个共享的$\delta$-ELOTE协议。相对于ELOTE，它将几何平均$T_{95}$降低了$58.90\%$，同时对所有带符号反应差值保持化学精度。这些经经典验证的结果表明，共享协议可在分子和反应之间节省成本，并激发了类似搜索：其中来自量子计算机的能量测量引导编码智能体循环中的探索。

items.title_en: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 为覆盖而收集，以证据回放：面向长时程智能体的自适应高效同策略蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.
items.abstract_zh: 完全在线同策略蒸馏（OPD）对长时程智能体而言代价高昂，因为每次更新都依赖于新的环境rollout。前缀回放通过从存储的历史中采样当前学生的响应，提供了一种高效替代方案，减少了长尾rollout的空闲时间，并使每条收集的轨迹能够支持多次更新。然而，我们对完整前缀回放流程的分析识别出长时程设置中的两个局限。在轨迹收集方面，仅教师轨迹会遗漏学生引发的历史，而更广泛的历史覆盖可能降低教师可靠性。在轨迹重用方面，固定的基于位置的调度无法识别可能出现在任意轨迹深度的关键决策。我们引入CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence）来解决这两个局限。学生播种的教师补全和响应级置信度门控扩展了历史覆盖，同时过滤不可靠更新。事后回放分配随后利用下游执行证据来选择有影响的轮次。在长时程任务软件工程和深度研究中，CARE-OPD优于在线OPD和先前的前缀回放基线。在SWE-bench Verified上，相对于异步在线OPD，它将任务成功率提高到59.5%，同时将端到端训练时间减少45%，环境动作减少44%。

items.title_en: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
items.title_zh: iMFPO：通过漂移感知速度对齐改进用于具身控制的平均流策略优化
items.abstract_en: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO.
items.abstract_zh: 基于流的生成策略为具身控制提供了富有表现力的动作建模，但在奖励驱动的策略优化下实现高效的一步生成仍然具有挑战性。特别是，在线强化学习过程中动作分布的演化可能在瞬时速度学习与区间平均动作生成之间引入不一致。为应对这一挑战，我们提出iMFPO，一个具有解耦速度学习和漂移感知速度对齐的一步生成策略优化框架。一个共享的区间条件actor支持瞬时速度监督和区间平均动作生成。JVP校正的速度回归与奖励驱动的策略目标联合优化，并在训练期间接受来自冻结PPO教师的动作级指导。在推理时，iMFPO通过区间平均速度预测直接生成动作，无需迭代流积分即可实现一步控制。在Go2、G1、H1和Spot上，零潜变量评估的平均回报分别为35.69、34.44、416.23和29.86。在Go2上，相对于64步RFPO，动作生成延迟从15.57 ms降至0.41 ms。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO。
